Message 338 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: How long shall we leave{line+}it hither?
entries.text: {Frog}: كم من الزمان سنتركه ها هنا؟

entries.context: Message 339 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: …{line+}No change.
Message 340 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: Now, let us go.
Message 341 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: It's gone!!{line+}The Moon Stone is gone!
Message 342 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    It looks like it's been gone for ages.{line+}Let's try another time period.
entries.text: يبدو أنه اختفى منذ زمن بعيد.{line}لنجرب حقبة زمنية أخرى.

entries.context: Message 343 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: It isn't here either.
Message 344 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    I wonder if someone from this time{line+}period has taken it?
entries.text: أتساءل هل أخذه أحد من هذه الحقبة الزمنية؟

entries.context: Message 345 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: It's not here!{line+}The Moon Stone is gone!
Message 346 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    It's been gone for ages.{line+}Let's check out another time.
entries.text: لقد اختفى منذ زمن طويل.{line}لنتفقد عصرا آخر.

entries.context: Message 347 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Not here either…
Message 348 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Did someone from this age take it?
entries.text: هل أخذه أحد من هذا العصر؟

entries.context: Message 349 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: It isn't here!!{line+}The Moon Stone isn't anywhere.
entries.text: {Robo}: إنه ليس هنا!!{line}لا وجود لحجر القمر في أي مكان.

entries.context: Message 350 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    It wasn't taken recently, though.{line+}Let's go back in time a bit.
entries.text: غير أنه لم يؤخذ حديثا.{line}فلنعد قليلا إلى الماضي.

entries.context: Message 351 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Doesn't look like it's here{line+}either.
Message 352 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Has someone from this era taken it?
entries.text: هل أخذه أحد من هذه الحقبة؟

entries.context: Message 353 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: The Moon Stone, 'tis gone!
Message 354 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Yet it hast not been taken recently.{line+}Let us return in time.
entries.text: بيد أنه لم يؤخذ في عهد قريب.{line}فلنرجع في الزمن إلى الوراء.

entries.context: Message 355 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: Not here either…
Message 356 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Hast someone from this time taken{line+}it?
entries.text: أترى أحدا من هذا الزمان قد أخذه؟

entries.context: Message 357 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: …{line+}Gone…rock not here?
Message 358 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    But plenty dust.{line+}Someone take long time ago.
entries.text: لكن غبار كثير.{line}أحدهم أخذ منذ زمن طويل.

entries.context: Message 359 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: Not here too.
Message 360 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    Someone take!{line+}We find!
Message 361 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: …{line+}The Moon Stone is gone.
Message 362 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):    …{box+}Seems it's been gone for 1300 years{line+}or so.{line+}Let's get back to the present.
entries.text:
…
يبدو أنه اختفى منذ نحو 1300 عام.{line}فلنعد إلى الحاضر.

entries.context: Message 363 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: It hasn't been gone for long.{line+}Let's take a look around.
entries.text: {Magus}: لم يمض على اختفائه وقت طويل.{line}فلنلق نظرة في الأرجاء.

entries.context: Message 364 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Amazing!{line+}With THIS much energy I can make a{line+}powerful weapon!{line+}Let's go back to my house now!
entries.text: {Lucca}: مذهل!{line}بكل هذه الطاقة يمكنني صنع سلاح قوي!{line}لنعد إلى منزلي الآن!

entries.context: Message 365 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: This really is the Sun Stone!{line+}With this energy, I can make an{line+}incredible weapon!{line+}Let's get back to my house quickly!
entries.text: {Lucca}: إنه حجر الشمس حقا!{line}بهذه الطاقة يمكنني صنع سلاح لا يصدق!{line}لنعد إلى منزلي بسرعة!

entries.context: Message 366 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Acck! This is amazing!{line+}{Lucca} can surely put this to good{line+}use!{line+}Let's show it to her!
entries.text: {Marle}: يا إلهي! هذا مذهل!{line}لا شك أن {Lucca} ستحسن استخدامه!{line}لنعرضه عليها!

entries.context: Message 367 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: My sensors read high energy{line+}levels.{line+}{Lucca} may be able to use this.{line+}Let us show it to her.
entries.text: {Robo}: مستشعراتي تسجل مستويات طاقة عالية.{line}ربما تستطيع {Lucca} الاستفادة من هذا.{line}لنعرضه عليها.

entries.context: Message 368 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: T, 'tis amazing…!{line+}What might {Lucca} create with it?{line+}She must see this!
entries.text: {Frog}: إ، إنه لأمر عجاب…!{line}ترى ما عسى {Lucca} أن تصنع به؟{line}لا بد أن تراه بعينيها!

entries.context: Message 369 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: Wow!{line+}The sun!{line+}{Lucca} maybe use?{line+}Bring {Lucca} here!
Message 370 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: The Sun Stone has regained{line+}its luster but…{box+}How might we harness its energy?
entries.text:
{Magus}: استعاد حجر الشمس بريقه، لكن…
كيف السبيل إلى تسخير طاقته؟

entries.context: Message 371 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Analysis complete.{box+}Please follow me.

Message 372 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Who enters here unbidden?{line}Oh…{box}Welcome home R-66Y.{line}Or should I say, Prometheus?!{line}You dare to defile this place with{line}humans?{box}I haven't seen them in ages.{line}Let me…welcome them.{line}Come closer…
entries.text:
من ذا الذي يدخل هنا دون إذن؟{line}أوه…
مرحبا بعودتك إلى الديار يا آر66-واي.{line}أم الأحرى أن أناديك بروميثيوس؟!{line}أتجرؤ على تدنيس هذا المكان بإحضار البشر إليه؟
لم أر بشرا منذ دهور.{line}دعني… أرحب بهم.{line}اقتربوا…

entries.context: Message 373 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Let's see just what you can do…
Message 374 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Not bad…for humans.{line}But can you find your way to me?
entries.text: لا بأس بكم… بالنسبة إلى بشر.{line}لكن هل تجدون طريقكم إلي؟

entries.context: Message 375 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): 300 yrs. ago the Lavos disaster greatly{line}changed the planet.{line}At this rate, humans will die out from{line}pure despair.
entries.text: قبل 300 عام، بدلت كارثة لافوس وجه الكوكب.{line}وعلى هذا المنوال، سينقرض البشر من فرط اليأس.

entries.context: Message 376 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Don't you understand?{line}This planet would be peaceful if there{line}were no humans around.{box}And yet you still want to fight?{line}Why?
entries.text:
ألا تفهمون؟{line}كان هذا الكوكب لينعم بالسلام لو لم يكن فيه بشر.
ومع ذلك ما زلتم تريدون القتال؟{line}لماذا؟

entries.context: Message 377 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Listen well, humans.{box}Lavos's children will one day have to{line}leave to seek new planets, and prey.{box}This world COULD sustain them…if{line}humans were not around…{box}We robots will create a new order…{line}A nation of steel, and pure logic.{line}A true paradise!{box}Our “Species” will replace you…{box}So stop your foolish struggle, and{line}succumb to the sleep of eternity…
entries.text:
أصغوا جيدا أيها البشر.
سيتحتم على صغار لافوس يوما ما أن يرحلوا بحثا عن كواكب جديدة، وعن فرائس.
كان بوسع هذا العالم أن يغذيهم… لو خلا من البشر…
نحن الروبوتات سنقيم نظاما جديدا…{line}أمة من الفولاذ والمنطق الخالص.{line}جنة حقيقية!
سيحل «نوعنا» محلكم…
فكفوا عن مقاومتكم الحمقاء، واستسلموا لسبات الأبدية…

entries.context: Message 378 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You did well to come this far.{line}I am the Mother Brain of the R-Y{line}series factory.{box}Come Prometheus, you must once{line}again join us.{box}I'll reset your circuitry and erase your{line}memories.{box}Then we'll dispose of these filthy{line}humans.
entries.text:
لقد أحسنتم صنعا بوصولكم إلى هنا.{line}أنا الدماغ الأم لمصنع سلسلة آر-واي.
تعال يا بروميثيوس، عليك أن تنضم إلينا من جديد.
سأعيد ضبط دوائرك وأمحو ذكرياتك.
ثم نتخلص من هؤلاء البشر الأقذار.

entries.context: Message 379 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: ……

Message 380 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: I'm sorry but…{line+}I cannot afford to lose anything{line+}else…{box+}Not my precious memories, or my{line+}irreplaceable friends.
entries.text:
{Robo}: أنا آسف، لكن…{line}لا أحتمل خسارة أي شيء آخر…
لا ذكرياتي الثمينة، ولا أصدقائي الذين لا يعوضون.

entries.context: Message 381 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You would betray ME, to stay with{line}these humans?{line}You would turn against the family of{line}robots?
entries.text: أتخونني أنا، كي تبقى مع هؤلاء البشر؟{line}أتنقلب على عائلة الروبوتات؟

entries.context: Message 382 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Humans have taught me{line+}much.{line+}{Crono}, {Marle}, {Lucca},{line+}{Frog}, and {Ayla}…{box+}I will not betray my friends.
entries.text:
{Robo}: لقد علمني البشر الكثير.{line}{Crono} و{Marle} و{Lucca}{line}و{Frog} و{Ayla}…
لن أخون أصدقائي.

entries.context: Message 383 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Ho…!{box}Fu, hu, hu…

Message 384 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): This is rich…!{line}Don't make me laugh!{line}YOU, have emotions?!{box}I'll show you just how “human” you've{line}become!
entries.text:
يا لها من نكتة…!{line}لا تضحكني!{line}أنت… تملك مشاعر؟!
سأريك كم أصبحت «بشريا»!

entries.context: Message 385 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): P…Pro…me…theus…{line}W…why…?
Message 386 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: This computer can give us{line+}data about the Geno Dome.
entries.text: {Robo}: يمكن لهذا الحاسوب أن يزودنا ببيانات عن قبة جينو.

entries.context: Message 387 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...):       Door{line+}   Conveyor Belt{line+}   Guard Machine{line+}   Doll
Message 388 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Enter the “Dust Chute?”{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 389 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}         Found a Power Tab!
Message 390 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}         Found a Magic Tab!
Message 391 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: What shall we examine{line+}first?

Message 392 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): To open locked doors, simply charge{line}the energy pods beside them.{box}Energize first, in the pod to your left,{line}then enter the pod next to a locked{line}door.
entries.text:
لفتح الأبواب المقفلة، يكفي أن تشحن كبسولات الطاقة المجاورة لها.
تزود بالطاقة أولا في الكبسولة التي على يسارك، ثم ادخل الكبسولة المجاورة لباب مقفل.

entries.context: Message 393 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The robot guarding the figurine will{line}block anyone that tries to pass.{line}But if you place 2 guards in front of{line}each other, they will short circuit.{box}Return the broken guard to the room{line}upstairs.
entries.text:
الروبوت الذي يحرس الدمية سيعترض طريق كل من يحاول المرور. لكن إن وضعت حارسين وجها لوجه، فسيصيبهما ماس كهربائي.
أعد الحارس المعطل إلى غرفة الطابق العلوي.

entries.context: Message 394 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): The belt conveyor to the right can be{line}reversed with a switch above it.
entries.text: يمكن عكس اتجاه السير الناقل الذي على اليمين بالمفتاح الذي فوقه.

entries.context: Message 395 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): You must obtain the 2 figurines on this{line}floor to fight the Mother Brain.{line}Do not leave with them.
entries.text: عليك الحصول على الدميتين اللتين في هذا الطابق لمواجهة الدماغ الأم.{line}لا تغادر وهما معك.

entries.context: Message 396 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Anything else?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 397 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: It's too well guarded.{line+}We have to destroy the central{line+}computer.
entries.text: {Robo}: الحراسة مشددة للغاية.{line}يتعين علينا تدمير الحاسوب المركزي.

entries.context: Message 398 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: What IS this?!{line+}We have to do something!
entries.text: {Marle}: ما هذا بحق السماء؟!{line}علينا أن نفعل شيئا!

entries.context: Message 399 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Wh, what the…?!{line+}Let's help them!!
Message 400 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: What be this?!{line+}We must rescue them!
entries.text: {Frog}: ما هذا الذي أرى؟!{line}لزام علينا أن ننقذهم!

entries.context: Message 401 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: !!{line+}People there!{line+}We help!
Message 402 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: Hmm…{line+}A human processing plant?
Message 403 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Let us stop the machine!
Message 404 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Aaa!
Message 405 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Aack!
Message 406 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: Arrgh!
Message 407 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: !!
Message 408 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: All machines in the factory{line+}have been shut off for good.
entries.text: {Robo}: لقد أطفئت جميع آلات المصنع نهائيا.

entries.context: Message 409 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: {Robo}……
Message 410 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: {Robo}……
Message 411 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: {Robo}……
Message 412 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: {Robo}??
Message 413 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: Hmph!{line+}We're leaving!
Message 414 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Let's go…!
Message 415 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ROBOT: Welcome home, Prometheus.
entries.text: الروبوت: مرحبا بعودتك إلى الديار يا بروميثيوس.

entries.context: Message 416 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: … …{line+}Atropos…?
Message 417 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Yes, it's been awhile{line+}Prometheus.{line+}You can stop pretending now and{line+}join us.
entries.text: أتروبوس: نعم، لقد مر وقت طويل يا بروميثيوس.{line}بوسعك الآن أن تكف عن التظاهر وتنضم إلينا.

entries.context: Message 418 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: Pretending?
Message 419 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Pretending?
Message 420 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: This has been a guise?
Message 421 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: ??
Message 422 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: ……

Message 423 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Mwa, ha…{line+}Unlike the other R-series,{line+}Prometheus had a special task.{box+}To live with humans and study them{line+}as a species…
entries.text:
أتروبوس: ها، ها…{line}بخلاف بقية روبوتات سلسلة آر، كانت لبروميثيوس مهمة خاصة.
أن يعيش بين البشر ويدرس نوعهم…

entries.context: Message 424 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Marle}: No…!
Message 425 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: That's a lie!
Message 426 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Frog}: Impossible…!
Message 427 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: What you say?!{line+}{Ayla} no understand.
Message 428 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Magus}: I see…
Message 429 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Tell them, Prometheus…
Message 430 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: ……
Message 431 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Now step back Prometheus.{line+}We'll get rid of these humans, then{line+}go see Mother…
entries.text: أتروبوس: والآن تنح جانبا يا بروميثيوس.{line}سنتخلص من هؤلاء البشر، ثم نذهب إلى الأم…

entries.context: Message 432 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Ayla}: ……
Message 433 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: What are you doing{line+}Prometheus?
Message 434 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: I won't allow you to hurt{line+}them!
Message 435 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: ……{line+}You are indeed defective.{line+}They have tampered with you.{line+}I'll destroy them, then fix you.
entries.text: أتروبوس: ……{line}أنت معطوب فعلا.{line}لقد عبثوا بك.{line}سأدمرهم، ثم أصلحك.

entries.context: Message 436 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Atropos… you've changed.
Message 437 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Indeed. Mother remade me to{line+}eliminate humans more efficiently!{box+}Step back, Prometheus!
entries.text:
أتروبوس: أجل. لقد أعادت الأم صنعي لأقضي على البشر بكفاءة أكبر!
تنح جانبا يا بروميثيوس!

entries.context: Message 438 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: My name is {Robo}.
Message 439 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: Prometheus!!
Message 440 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Wait!{line+}Stand back and leave this to me.
Message 441 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): System down…{line}Delete program…
Message 442 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: P, Prometheus…?{line+}It's been…ages…!
entries.text: أتروبوس: ب… بروميثيوس…؟{line}لقد مر… زمن طويل…!

entries.context: Message 443 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Atropos…?
Message 444 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: I'm damaged?{line+}What happened?
Message 445 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Atropos!!
Message 446 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: My memory bank…{box+}Mother must have done something{line+}nasty when she reprogrammed me…
entries.text:
أتروبوس: وحدة ذاكرتي…
لا بد أن الأم فعلت بي شيئا خبيثا حين أعادت برمجتي…

entries.context: Message 447 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Partial memory…restored…{line}I'm sorry…Prometheus…
entries.text: تمت استعادة… جزء من الذاكرة…{line}أنا آسفة… يا بروميثيوس…

entries.context: Message 448 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Lucca}: Save your strength!{line+}I'll patch you up.
Message 449 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: It isn't possi…ble…{line+}Vital functions are do…wn…{line+}M…memory bank damaged…
entries.text: أتروبوس: هذا غير… ممكن…{line}الوظائف الحيوية متو…قفة…{line}و… وحدة الذاكرة تالفة…

entries.context: Message 450 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {Robo}: Atropos…!

Message 451 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): ATROPOS: This…is for you…{line+}You can…plug this…into your circuits…{line+}Please…take care…of it…{line+}Good…bye…Pro…metheus…
entries.text: أتروبوس: هذا… لك…{line}يمكنك… توصيل هذا… بدوائرك…{line}أرجوك… أن تعتني… به…{line}ودا…عا… يا برو…ميثيوس…

entries.context: Message 452 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): Atropos' Ribbon ups {Robo}'s Speed{line}by 3 and Magic Defense by 10.
entries.text: شريط أتروبوس يرفع سرعة {Robo} بمقدار 3{line}والدفاع السحري بمقدار 10.

entries.context: Message 453 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}      All functions are down…
Message 454 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line}  Got the Terra Arm and the Crisis Arm!
Message 455 of the truce table (Crono's house and Truce in 1000 and in 600...): {line+}         Found a Speed Tab!
Message 0 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line}1/11 1G version
Message 1 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line+}    Sealed by a mysterious force……
Message 2 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line+}          You got 1 {item}!
Message 3 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Princess!{line}Wearing our disguise again, are we?
entries.text: أيتها الأميرة!{line}متنكرة مرة أخرى، أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 4 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): My, your majesty, you look splendid!
entries.text: يا سلام، كم تبدين بهية يا صاحبة السمو!

entries.context: Message 5 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Princess!{line}I see you're dressing…normally again!
entries.text: أيتها الأميرة!{line}أرى أنك عدت ترتدين… ملابس عادية!

entries.context: Message 6 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Something doesn't look{line+}right…
Message 7 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Let's return to the castle!
Message 8 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Wahhh!{line}Where's my cat?!!
Message 9 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): You brought back my cat!{line}Thank you!
Message 10 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Guess the winner?{line+}   Sure!{line+}   No thanks.
Message 11 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line+}    Yum!{line+}Tastes like chicken!
Message 12 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Last round's winner: …{box}Steel Runner!
entries.text:
الفائز في الجولة السابقة هو…
العداء الفولاذي!

entries.context: Message 13 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Last round's winner: …{box}Green Ambler.
entries.text:
الفائز في الجولة السابقة هو…
المتمهل الأخضر.

entries.context: Message 14 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Last round's winner: …{box}Catalack.
entries.text:
الفائز في الجولة السابقة هو…
كاتالاك.

entries.context: Message 15 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Last round's winner: …{box}G. I. Jogger.
entries.text:
الفائز في الجولة السابقة هو…
الجندي الراكض.

entries.context: Message 16 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...):       A. Steel Runner!{line+}   B. Green Ambler!{line+}   C. Catalack!{line+}   D. G. I. Jogger!
entries.text: {choice}أ. العداء الفولاذي!{line}{choice}ب. المتمهل الأخضر!{line}{choice}ج. كاتالاك!{line}{choice}د. الجندي الراكض!

entries.context: Message 17 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): You can't earn any more points!
entries.text: لا يمكنك كسب مزيد من النقاط!

entries.context: Message 18 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): The race is on.{line}Be quiet and watch!
Message 19 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): The Steel Runner might try something.
entries.text: قد يفاجئنا العداء الفولاذي بشيء ما.

entries.context: Message 20 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I knew it!{line}It's the Green Ambler!
Message 21 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Catalack, you're a sure bet!
entries.text: يا كاتالاك، الرهان عليك لا يخيب!

entries.context: Message 22 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Can't anyone beat G. I. Jogger?
entries.text: ألا يستطيع أحد هزيمة الجندي الراكض؟

entries.context: Message 23 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Not bad!{line}I'll put 5 Silver Points on your card.
entries.text: ليس سيئا!{line}سأضيف 5 نقاط فضية إلى بطاقتك.

entries.context: Message 24 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): That's great!{line}I'll put your 20 Silver Points on the{line}card!
Message 25 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Press the A Button while facing the{line}bell. Judge your distance carefully, and{line}press the A Button again!
entries.text: اضغط زر إيه وأنت تواجه الجرس. احسب المسافة بعناية، ثم اضغط زر إيه مرة أخرى!

entries.context: Message 26 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Impressive!{line}I'll put 1 Silver Point on your card!
entries.text: مذهل!{line}سأضيف نقطة فضية واحدة إلى بطاقتك!

entries.context: Message 27 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Oh, my!{line}It's…the pendant…!{box}Er, sorry, but I can't buy that!{line}It's…far too special!{line}Keep it safe!
entries.text:
يا إلهي!{line}إنها… القلادة…!
أمم، آسف، لكنني لا أستطيع شراءها!{line}إنها… أثمن من أن تباع!{line}حافظ عليها جيدا!

entries.context: Message 28 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Buy something from Melchior,{line}the swordsmith?{box+}   Sure.{line+}   No thanks.
entries.text:
أتشتري شيئا من ملكيور صانع السيوف؟
{choice}بالتأكيد.{line}{choice}لا، شكرا.

entries.context: Message 29 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): By the way…{box}Could you talk that young lady into{line}selling her pendant?{line+}   I'll try.{line+}   No.
entries.text:
بالمناسبة…
هل يمكنك إقناع تلك الشابة{line}ببيع قلادتها؟{line}{choice}سأحاول.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 30 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): MELCHIOR: I live on the continent to the{line+}east.{line+}Come see me sometime…
entries.text: ملكيور: أعيش في القارة الواقعة شرقا.{line}زرني يوما ما…

entries.context: Message 31 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): It's a soda guzzling contest!{line}Press the A Button as fast as you can!
entries.text: إنها مسابقة شرب الصودا بنهم!{line}اضغط زر إيه بأسرع ما يمكنك!

entries.context: Message 32 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Ready?{line}Set?{line}Go!
Message 33 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Only {code 0D} cans?{line}Is that the best you can do?!
entries.text: شربت {code 0D} علبة فقط؟{line}أهذا أقصى ما لديك؟!

entries.context: Message 34 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Not too shabby!
Message 35 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): You're too much, kid!
Message 36 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Hey!!
Message 37 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Ouch, that hurt!
Message 38 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: I'm so sorry!{line+}Are you okay?
entries.text: الفتاة: أنا آسفة جدا!{line}هل أنت بخير؟

entries.context: Message 39 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Uh oh…{line+}My pendant!
Message 40 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Oh, no!{line+}Don't tell me I lost it!
entries.text: الفتاة: أوه، لا!{line}لا يعقل أن أكون قد أضعتها!

entries.context: Message 41 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Oh, thank goodness!{line+}My pendant!{line+}It has a lot of sentimental value!{box+}May I have it back?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text:
الفتاة: أوه، الحمد لله!{line}قلادتي!{line}إنها عزيزة جدا على قلبي!
هلا أعدتها إلي؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 42 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: It's a family heirloom.{line+}May I please have it back?
entries.text: {Marle}: إنها إرث عائلي.{line}أرجوك، هلا أعدتها إلي؟

entries.context: Message 43 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...):    I came to see the Festival!{line+}You…live in this town, don't you?!{line+}I feel a little out of place here.{box+}Would you mind if I walked around{line+}with you for a while?{line+}   Sure.{line+}   Sorry.
entries.text:
جئت لأرى المهرجان!{line}أنت… تعيش في هذه البلدة، أليس كذلك؟!{line}أشعر ببعض الغربة هنا.
هل تسمح لي أن أتجول{line}معك قليلا؟{line}{choice}بالتأكيد.{line}{choice}آسف.

entries.context: Message 44 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Oh, come on! I don't know anyone{line+}around here! Please!{line+}   Ok.{line+}   No.
entries.text: الفتاة: أوه، هيا! لا أعرف أحدا هنا!{line}أرجوك!{line}{choice}حسنا.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 45 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: You're a true gentleman!
Message 46 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: Oh, by the way…{line+}My name is, er…
Message 47 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): GIRL: …um, {Marle}!{line+}And you're?
Message 48 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: {Crono}?{line+}What a nice name!{line+}Pleased to meet you!{line+}Now, lead on!
entries.text: {Marle}: {Crono}؟{line}يا له من اسم جميل!{line}سررت بلقائك!{line}والآن، تقدم وأنا أتبعك!

entries.context: Message 49 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Welcome to the Millennial Fair!{line}Have fun!
entries.text: مرحبا بك في مهرجان الألفية!{line}استمتع بوقتك!

entries.context: Message 50 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I heard the Princess ran away from{line}home again!
entries.text: سمعت أن الأميرة هربت من القصر مرة أخرى!

entries.context: Message 51 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): This is the renowned{line}“Tent of Horrors!”{line}Spend your {code 0D} Silver Points here!{line}Parental discretion advised.
entries.text: هذه هي «خيمة الرعب» الشهيرة!{line}لديك {code 0D} نقطة فضية، فأنفقها هنا!{line}ينصح بإشراف الوالدين.

entries.context: Message 52 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): No time to talk.{line}I'm just sitting down for my lunch.
entries.text: لا وقت لدي للكلام.{line}جلست للتو لأتناول غدائي.

entries.context: Message 53 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Those runners are busy racing, so they{line}won't talk to you.
entries.text: أولئك العداؤون مشغولون بالسباق،{line}فلن يتحدثوا إليك.

entries.context: Message 54 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): This Kingdom's been through a lot,{line}like the war against {Magus},{line}400 years ago.{box}Thank goodness things are so peaceful{line}now.
entries.text:
مرت هذه المملكة بالكثير، كالحرب على {Magus} قبل 400 عام.
الحمد لله أن السلام يعم البلاد الآن.

entries.context: Message 55 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I heard this guy pays big bucks for{line}charms, weapons, pendants, and other{line}rarities.
entries.text: سمعت أن هذا الرجل يدفع مبالغ طائلة مقابل التمائم والأسلحة والقلائد وغيرها من النوادر.

entries.context: Message 56 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Keep going if you want to demo{line}{Lucca}'s robot battle trainer!{line}Collect Silver Points if you win!
entries.text: تابع طريقك إن أردت تجربة روبوت {Lucca} للتدريب على القتال!{line}ستحصل على نقاط فضية إن فزت!

entries.context: Message 57 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): This is Leene Square. They say people{line}who hear Leene's Bell ring will have{line}interesting and happy lives!
entries.text: هذه ساحة لين. يقولون إن من يسمع رنين جرس لين سيحظى بحياة شيقة وسعيدة!

entries.context: Message 58 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): What's the big deal?{line}So what if we won a war against a{line}Wizard hundreds of years ago!
entries.text: ما كل هذه الضجة؟{line}انتصرنا في حرب على ساحر قبل مئات السنين،{line}فماذا في ذلك؟!

entries.context: Message 59 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): They're still setting up.{line}Why don't you come back in a while?
entries.text: ما زالوا يجهزون المكان.{line}ما رأيك أن تعود بعد قليل؟

entries.context: Message 60 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I heard {Lucca} and her dad have{line}made another crazy invention.{box}Hope it doesn't blow up like all the{line}others!
entries.text:
سمعت أن {Lucca} وأباها صنعا اختراعا جنونيا آخر.
أرجو ألا ينفجر مثل كل سابقاته!

entries.context: Message 61 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): They ought to be ready now.{line}Make for the far side of the Square.{box}{Marle}: This is going to be fun!{line+}Come on, {Crono}!
entries.text:
لا بد أنهما جاهزان الآن.{line}توجه إلى الطرف الآخر من الساحة.
{Marle}: سيكون هذا ممتعا!{line}هيا يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 62 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}'s device is all set up.{line}She's at the north end of the Square.
entries.text: جهاز {Lucca} جاهز تماما.{line}إنها في الطرف الشمالي من الساحة.

entries.context: Message 63 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Hold your horses!{line+}I want to get some candy.
entries.text: {Marle}: على رسلك!{line}أريد أن أشتري بعض الحلوى.

entries.context: Message 64 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Give me just a second!
Message 65 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: There's no need to drag me{line+}by the arm like some kidnapper!
entries.text: {Marle}: لا داعي لأن تجرني من ذراعي وكأنك خاطف!

entries.context: Message 66 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Hi!{line+}I'd like some of this.{box}LADY: Sure, young lady.
entries.text:
{Marle}: مرحبا!{line}أريد بعضا من هذا.
السيدة: بالتأكيد يا آنسة.

entries.context: Message 67 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Thanks for waiting!
Message 68 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Hee, hee.{line+}You're such a pig, {Crono}!
Message 69 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: You're so sweet, {Crono}!
Message 70 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: You're awfully competitive,{line+}aren't you, {Crono}?
Message 71 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: {Crono}…{line+}I'm having a great time!
Message 72 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): The merchants went back to their{line}warehouse to stock up on more goods.
entries.text: عاد التجار إلى مخزنهم ليتزودوا بمزيد من البضائع.

entries.context: Message 73 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): You have {code 0D} Silver Points.{box}Want to exchange 10 Silver Points{line}for 50 G?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text:
رصيدك من النقاط الفضية {code 0D}.
أتريد تحويل 10 نقاط فضية{line}إلى 50 قطعة ذهبية؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 74 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Not enough Silver Points.
Message 75 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Come again.
Message 76 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I hate fairs!{line}Say, do you know the latest gossip?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 77 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Then scram!

Message 78 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Just between us, I heard that the King{line}is distressed over his tomboy of a{line}daughter!{box}Just once, I would like to see how wild{line}she really is!
entries.text:
بيني وبينك، سمعت أن الملك مهموم بسبب ابنته التي تتصرف كالصبيان!
أتمنى أن أرى ولو مرة واحدة كم هي جامحة حقا!

entries.context: Message 79 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Step right on up, any of you{line+}who have the time and the courage!{line+}Our “Super Dimension Warp” is the{line+}invention of the century!
entries.text: تابان: هلموا وتقدموا يا من تملكون الوقت والشجاعة!{line}جهازنا «الانتقال فوق البعدي» هو اختراع القرن!

entries.context: Message 80 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: To use it, jump up here…
Message 81 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: …and you'll get teleported here!{line+}It's the masterwork of my beautiful{line+}daughter, {Lucca}.
entries.text: تابان: …وستنتقل إلى هنا في لمح البصر!{line}إنه تحفة ابنتي الجميلة، {Lucca}.

entries.context: Message 82 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Give it a try, kid?{line+}…Oh, it's you, {Crono}!
entries.text: تابان: أتريد أن تجربه يا فتى؟{line}…أوه، هذا أنت يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 83 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Don't worry, we tried it on our{line+}pets!{line+}There's no reason why it shouldn't{line+}work as well on humans!{box+}So, step right up!
entries.text:
تابان: لا تقلق، لقد جربناه على حيواناتنا الأليفة!{line}ولا يوجد ما يمنع نجاحه مع البشر أيضا!
فهيا، تقدم!

entries.context: Message 84 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: It…WORKED?!{line+}I CAN'T BELIEVE IT!{box+}Uh, er, a thrilling display of science at{line+}its best, ladies and gentlemen!
entries.text:
تابان: لقد… نجح؟!{line}لا أصدق ذلك!
إحم، أقصد، عرض مذهل للعلم في أبهى صوره، سيداتي وسادتي!

entries.context: Message 85 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: {Crono}!
Message 86 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Where have you been!?{line+}No one wants to try the Telepod!{box+}How about you?
entries.text:
{Lucca}: أين كنت؟!{line}لا أحد يريد أن يجرب جهاز النقل الآني!
ما رأيك أن تجربه أنت؟

entries.context: Message 87 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Just hop onto the left pod!
entries.text: {Lucca}: ما عليك إلا أن تقفز إلى المنصة اليسرى!

entries.context: Message 88 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: So, how was it?{line+}Want to try it again?
entries.text: {Lucca}: إذن، كيف وجدته؟{line}أتريد أن تجربه مرة أخرى؟

entries.context: Message 89 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: It looks like fun!{line+}I'll watch while you try it out!
entries.text: {Marle}: يبدو هذا ممتعا!{line}سأتفرج عليك وأنت تجربه!

entries.context: Message 90 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: What a kick!{line+}I want to try it, too!
entries.text: {Marle}: يا للمتعة!{line}أريد أن أجربه أنا أيضا!

entries.context: Message 91 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Huh?
Message 92 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Hey {Crono}, how did you{line+}pick up a cutie like her?
entries.text: {Lucca}: اسمع يا {Crono}، كيف أوقعت فتاة جميلة كهذه في شباكك؟

entries.context: Message 93 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Hang on, {Crono}!{line+}I'll be right there!
Message 94 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Behold, ladies and gentlemen, as{line+}this vision of loveliness steps aboard{line+}the machine!
entries.text: تابان: انظروا، سيداتي وسادتي، إلى هذه الآية في الجمال وهي تصعد إلى الجهاز!

entries.context: Message 95 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Don't go away.{line+}I'll be right back!
Message 96 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: You're sure about this…?{line+}There's still time to change your{line+}mind!
entries.text: تابان: هل أنت متأكدة من هذا…؟{line}لا يزال أمامك وقت لتغيري رأيك!

entries.context: Message 97 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: No way!{line+}Throw the switch!
Message 98 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Okay, everyone, let's give her a{line+}great big hand when she reappears!
entries.text: تابان: حسنا أيها الحضور الكرام، لنصفق لها بحرارة حين تظهر من جديد!

entries.context: Message 99 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: All systems on!
Message 100 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Begin energy transfer!
Message 101 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: What's happening?{line+}My pendant…it's…
Message 102 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: She's so familiar!{line+}I KNOW I've seen her somewhere…
entries.text: {Lucca}: وجهها مألوف جدا!{line}أنا متأكدة أنني رأيتها في مكان ما…

entries.context: Message 103 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Huh?
Message 104 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): ALL: Oh wow.{line+}That was GREAT!
Message 105 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Hmm?
Message 106 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: {Lucca}!{line+}Where is she?!
Message 107 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: ……
Message 108 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Show's over, folks!{line+}Let's head along now!
entries.text: تابان: انتهى العرض أيها الجميع!{line}هيا، واصلوا طريقكم!

entries.context: Message 109 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: What's going on {Lucca}?{line+}WHERE IS SHE?

Message 110 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: The way she disappeared…{line+}It couldn't have been the Telepod!{box+}The warp field seemed to be{line+}affected by her pendant…
entries.text:
{Lucca}: طريقة اختفائها هذه…{line}لا يمكن أن يكون جهاز النقل الآني هو السبب!
بدا أن قلادتها أثرت في مجال الانتقال…

entries.context: Message 111 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: What are we going to do now?
Message 112 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: {Crono}!{line+}You brought her here, YOU get her{line+}back!
entries.text: {Lucca}: {Crono}!{line}أنت من أحضرها إلى هنا، فعليك أنت أن تعيدها!

entries.context: Message 113 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: {Crono}!
Message 114 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: You're actually going to do it?!{line+}What a fine lad!
entries.text: تابان: هل ستفعلها حقا؟!{line}يا لك من فتى شهم!

entries.context: Message 115 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Listen!{line+}I don't know where this machine is{line+}going to send you, but we haven't{line+}any other choice.{box}TABAN: Won't they both be lost?{box}{Lucca}: This is our only hope!{line+}That pendant seems to be the key, so{line+}hang on to it {Crono}, and brace{line+}yourself!
entries.text:
{Lucca}: اسمع!{line}لا أعرف إلى أين سيرسلك هذا الجهاز، لكن ليس لدينا خيار آخر.
تابان: ألن يضيع كلاهما؟
{Lucca}: هذا أملنا الوحيد!{line}يبدو أن تلك القلادة هي المفتاح، فتمسك بها يا {Crono}، واستعد!

entries.context: Message 116 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Power to full!
Message 117 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): TABAN: Roger!
Message 118 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: More!{line+}Give me more power!
Message 119 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: There!{line+}We did it!
Message 120 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: I'll follow you after I know{line+}what went wrong.{line+}Good luck, {Crono}!
entries.text: {Lucca}: سألحق بك بعد أن أعرف أين كان الخطأ.{line}حظا موفقا يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 121 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Phew!{line+}We're back!

Message 122 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: {Crono}, {Lucca}, why{line+}don't you come home with me to the{line+}castle?{line+}I'd like you to come over for dinner!
entries.text: {Marle}: {Crono}، {Lucca}، لماذا لا تأتيان معي إلى القلعة؟{line}أريد أن أدعوكما إلى العشاء!

entries.context: Message 123 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Sorry for putting you{line+}through all that, {Marle}.
entries.text: {Lucca}: آسفة لأنني عرضتك لكل هذا يا {Marle}.

entries.context: Message 124 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Are you joking?{line+}That's the most fun I've had in{line+}months!{line+}And I have some new friends, too!
entries.text: {Marle}: أتمزحين؟{line}لم أحظ بمتعة كهذه منذ شهور!{line}وصار لي أصدقاء جدد أيضا!

entries.context: Message 125 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: {Crono}, be a gentleman{line+}and take her home.{box+}I've got some work to do.
entries.text:
{Lucca}: {Crono}، كن شهما وأوصلها إلى بيتها.
أما أنا فلدي عمل علي إنجازه.

entries.context: Message 126 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: See you soon, {Lucca}!
Message 127 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Will you escort me home,{line+}{Crono}?
Message 128 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Check out that girl's glasses!
Message 129 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): She could probably see the back side of{line}the moon with those.
entries.text: لعلها ترى بتلك النظارة الوجه الآخر للقمر.

entries.context: Message 130 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Wow!
Message 131 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}'s inventions never work{line}right.
entries.text: اختراعات {Lucca} لا تعمل كما ينبغي أبدا.

entries.context: Message 132 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I guess even HER inventions have to{line}work, sometimes.
entries.text: أظن أنه حتى اختراعاتها هي لا بد أن تعمل أحيانا.

entries.context: Message 133 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I'm the lawyer, Pierre.
Message 134 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I'm the Chancellor, the prosecutor!

Message 135 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Members of the court.{box+}We now bring forth the defendant,{line+}{Crono}, who is charged with{line+}abducting Princess {Nadia}.
entries.text:
المستشار: أيها السادة أعضاء المحكمة.
نحضر الآن أمامكم المدعى عليه، {Crono}، المتهم باختطاف الأميرة ناديا.

entries.context: Message 136 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: What shall we do with{line+}him?{line+}Fire, perhaps?{box+}Hang him upside down for a few{line+}years?{box+}Or…shall we employ the guillotine?
entries.text:
المستشار: ماذا عسانا نفعل به؟{line}نحرقه، ربما؟
أنعلقه من قدميه بضع سنوات؟
أم… نلجأ إلى المقصلة؟

entries.context: Message 137 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: You, the jury, shall decide{line+}his fate.{line+}Now, let us begin.
entries.text: المستشار: أنتم يا أعضاء هيئة المحلفين من سيقرر مصيره.{line}والآن، فلنبدأ.

entries.context: Message 138 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): JUDGE: {Crono}, you are hereby{line+}ordered to tell the truth!
entries.text: القاضي: يا {Crono}، تأمرك المحكمة بقول الحقيقة!

entries.context: Message 139 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: {Crono} is charged with{line+}“Premeditated Abduction of Royalty.”{line+}The question is, did he kidnap{line+}Princess {Nadia}? The answer?{box+}No, he did not.{line+}In fact, no “abduction” took place!
entries.text:
بيير: {Crono} متهم بجريمة «اختطاف فرد من الأسرة المالكة مع سبق الإصرار».{line}والسؤال هو: هل اختطف الأميرة ناديا؟{line}والجواب؟
لا، لم يفعل.{line}بل إنه لم يقع أي «اختطاف» أصلا!

entries.context: Message 140 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: The two met completely by{line+}accident. In fact, the Princess ASKED{line+}{Crono} if SHE could join HIM!
entries.text: بيير: لقد التقى الاثنان بمحض الصدفة.{line}بل إن الأميرة هي من طلبت من {Crono} أن ترافقه!

entries.context: Message 141 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Is this true? Who actually{line+}started this whole mess?{line+}   I did.{line+}   {Marle} did.
entries.text: المستشار: أهذا صحيح؟ من الذي بدأ هذه الفوضى كلها حقا؟{line}{choice}أنا من بدأها.{line}{choice}{Marle} هي من بدأتها.

entries.context: Message 142 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Just as I suspected!{line+}The defendant deliberately tried to{line+}get near the Princess!
entries.text: المستشار: هذا بالضبط ما كنت أشك فيه!{line}لقد سعى المدعى عليه عمدا إلى الاقتراب من الأميرة!

entries.context: Message 143 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Are you sure?{line+}We have witnesses who'll say YOU{line+}were the one that bumped into the{line+}princess.
entries.text: المستشار: أأنت متأكد؟{line}لدينا شهود سيشهدون بأنك أنت من اصطدم بالأميرة.

entries.context: Message 144 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: The Princess then{line+}innocently followed you to{line+}{Lucca}'s little sideshow.{box+}Whereupon you both disappeared!{line+}If that wasn't criminal abduction, I{line+}don't know WHAT is!
entries.text:
المستشار: ثم تبعتك الأميرة بكل براءة إلى عرض {Lucca} الصغير.
وعندها اختفيتما معا!{line}إن لم يكن هذا اختطافا جنائيا، فما الاختطاف إذن؟!

entries.context: Message 145 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: And I have facts that{line+}throw the defendant's character into{line+}question!
entries.text: المستشار: ولدي حقائق تثير الشك في أخلاق المدعى عليه!

entries.context: Message 146 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: Objection!{box+}This can't have any relevance{line+}whatsoever to this case!
entries.text:
بيير: اعتراض!
لا يمكن أن يكون لهذا أي صلة بهذه القضية على الإطلاق!

entries.context: Message 147 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): JUDGE: Care to respond, Chancellor?
Message 148 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: {Crono}'s character is at{line+}the very core of this case!{box}PIERRE: We have nothing to hide.
entries.text:
المستشار: أخلاق {Crono} هي جوهر هذه القضية!
بيير: ليس لدينا ما نخفيه.

entries.context: Message 149 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: We have a witness.{line+}A little girl who will vouch for the{line+}character of the defendant.
entries.text: بيير: لدينا شاهدة.{line}فتاة صغيرة ستشهد على حسن أخلاق المدعى عليه.

entries.context: Message 150 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): This nice man…{line}He brought me my kitty.
entries.text: هذا الرجل الطيب…{line}أعاد إلي قطتي الصغيرة.

entries.context: Message 151 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Thank you for being so kind!
Message 152 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: How about that?{line+}Doesn't this young man deserve a{line+}medal?
entries.text: بيير: ما رأيكم في هذا؟{line}ألا يستحق هذا الشاب ميدالية؟

entries.context: Message 153 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: Whew…{line+}Looks like they're buying it.
Message 154 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: The defendant's cruelty is{line+}quite evident.
entries.text: المستشار: قسوة المدعى عليه واضحة للعيان.

entries.context: Message 155 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: You remember HER, don't{line+}you?{line+}The poor little girl who lost her cat?{line+}You wouldn't even listen to her!
entries.text: المستشار: أنت تذكرها، أليس كذلك؟{line}الفتاة الصغيرة المسكينة التي فقدت قطتها؟{line}لم تكلف نفسك حتى عناء الاستماع إليها!

entries.context: Message 156 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): You ignored me!
Message 157 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Oh you poor dear!{line+}Thank you.
entries.text: المستشار: آه يا صغيرتي المسكينة!{line}شكرا لك.

entries.context: Message 158 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: As you can see, no further{line+}proof is necessary here.
entries.text: المستشار: كما ترون، لا حاجة إلى مزيد من الأدلة هنا.

entries.context: Message 159 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Have you ever stolen{line+}anything?{line+}   Well…yes.{line+}   No! I've never been a thief.
entries.text: المستشار: هل سبق أن سرقت{line}شيئا؟{line}{choice}في الواقع… نعم.{line}{choice}لا! لم أكن لصا قط.

entries.context: Message 160 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: See!{line+}He lacks morals!{line+}This should be on the record!{line+}He's crying out for help!
entries.text: المستشار: أرأيتم!{line}إنه بلا أخلاق!{line}فليسجل هذا في المحضر!{line}سلوكه هذا صرخة استغاثة!

entries.context: Message 161 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: DO NOT feign ignorance!{line+}We have a witness.
entries.text: المستشار: إياك أن تتظاهر بالجهل!{line}لدينا شاهد.

entries.context: Message 162 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Him!{line}He ate my lunch right off the table!
entries.text: إنه هو!{line}لقد التهم غدائي من فوق المائدة!

entries.context: Message 163 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Let the record show that{line+}he stole from a poor, helpless man!
entries.text: المستشار: فليثبت في المحضر أنه سرق رجلا فقيرا لا حول له ولا قوة!

entries.context: Message 164 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PIERRE: The issue here is MOTIVE.{line+}Was there any motive for this fine{line+}citizen to kidnap Princess {Nadia}?{line+}No! There was none.
entries.text: بيير: لب المسألة هنا هو الدافع.{line}هل كان لهذا المواطن الصالح أي دافع لاختطاف الأميرة ناديا؟{line}لا! لم يكن هناك أي دافع.

entries.context: Message 165 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: What about ransom?{box+}{Crono}, her fortune DID tempt{line+}you, did it not?{line+}   No.{line+}   Yes.
entries.text:
المستشار: وماذا عن الفدية؟
{Crono}، لا شك أن ثروتها أغرتك، أليس كذلك؟{line}{choice}لا.{line}{choice}نعم.

entries.context: Message 166 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: So, you admit it!
Message 167 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Nothing more your honor.{line+}The prosecution rests.
entries.text: المستشار: ليس لدي ما أضيفه يا حضرة القاضي.{line}انتهت مرافعة الادعاء.

entries.context: Message 168 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Are you sure?{line+}You really weren't tempted?{line+}   Not at all.{line+}   Just a bit.
entries.text: المستشار: أأنت متأكد؟{line}أحقا لم تشعر بأي إغراء؟{line}{choice}إطلاقا.{line}{choice}قليلا فقط.

entries.context: Message 169 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: That's enough.{line+}I have no more questions.{box}PIERRE: It is evident that my client is a{line+}fine, noble young man!{line+}Your honor, the defense rests.
entries.text:
المستشار: هذا يكفي.{line}ليس لدي مزيد من الأسئلة.
بيير: من الواضح أن موكلي شاب صالح نبيل!{line}حضرة القاضي، انتهت مرافعة الدفاع.

entries.context: Message 170 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Please keep in mind that{line+}he just said he had NO interest in her{line+}fortune.{box+}Witness please!
entries.text:
المستشار: أرجو أن تضعوا في اعتباركم أنه قال للتو إن ثروتها لا تعنيه في شيء.
فليتقدم الشاهد!

entries.context: Message 171 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): He can't fool me, I saw him with my{line}own eyes!
entries.text: لا يمكنه أن يخدعني، فقد رأيته بعيني هاتين!

entries.context: Message 172 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Dear me!{line}I'm so nervous!
Message 173 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): That man grabbed the pendant even{line}before he checked to see if the{line}Princess was okay!
entries.text: ذلك الرجل أسرع إلى التقاط القلادة حتى قبل أن يطمئن على الأميرة!

entries.context: Message 174 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): He didn't seem to want to return it,{line}either.
entries.text: ولم يبد عليه أنه يريد إعادتها أيضا.

entries.context: Message 175 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): He tried to sell it to the merchant,{line}Melchior.
entries.text: لقد حاول أن يبيعها للتاجر ملكيور.

entries.context: Message 176 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: And this person's final bit{line+}of testimony will prove our case!
entries.text: المستشار: وما تبقى من شهادة هذا الشخص سيثبت صحة قضيتنا!

entries.context: Message 177 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): I heard it clearly.{line}I heard her cry out with my own ears!
entries.text: سمعت ذلك بوضوح.{line}سمعتها تصرخ بأذني هاتين!

entries.context: Message 178 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Is that it?{line}Can I go?!
Message 179 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): JUDGE: Members of the jury…{line+}If he is guilty, stand to the left.{line+}If innocent, stand to the right.
entries.text: القاضي: يا أعضاء هيئة المحلفين…{line}من يراه مذنبا فليقف إلى اليسار.{line}ومن يراه بريئا فليقف إلى اليمين.

entries.context: Message 180 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Guilty.
Message 181 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Not guilty.
Message 182 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): Order in the court!
Message 183 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): A verdict has been reached!
Message 184 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): We have a majority!
Message 185 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): The verdict is…guilty!{line}The sentence? Solitary confinement,{line}pending execution in 3 days!
entries.text: الحكم هو… مذنب!{line}والعقوبة؟ الحبس الانفرادي،{line}بانتظار الإعدام بعد 3 أيام!

entries.context: Message 186 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line}The verdict is…not guilty!{box}But the fact remains that even if he{line}did not kidnap her, he ran off with her.{line}3 days solitary confinement as{line}punishment.
entries.text:
{line}الحكم هو… غير مذنب!
لكن يبقى أنه هرب معها، حتى وإن لم يختطفها.{line}لذا فعقوبته الحبس الانفرادي 3 أيام.

entries.context: Message 187 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): CHANCELLOR: Take him away!
Message 188 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Now just a darn minute…{box}CHANCELLOR: Princess!
entries.text:
{Marle}: مهلا، انتظروا لحظة…
المستشار: سمو الأميرة!

entries.context: Message 189 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): KING: That's enough, my dear!

Message 190 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: But Father…!{box}KING: All I asked was for you to{line+}behave like a princess.{box+}Even royalty must obey rules.{line+}Leave the rest up to the Chancellor{line+}and forget about the events in town.
entries.text:
{Marle}: لكن يا أبي…!
الملك: كل ما طلبته منك أن تتصرفي كأميرة.
فحتى الأسرة المالكة عليها أن تلتزم بالقواعد.{line}دعي المستشار يتولى الباقي وانسي ما حدث في المدينة.

entries.context: Message 191 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): KING: We're leaving!
Message 192 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: {Crono}!!!
Message 193 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...):    Aaagh!
Message 194 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): BOY: Th, this is a terrible place!{line+}Y, you'd best run away while you{line+}can!
entries.text: الصبي: إ، إنه مكان مروع!{line}ي، يجدر بك أن تهرب ما دمت تستطيع!

entries.context: Message 195 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): The…Medal.{line}…The Hero's…Medal…
Message 196 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Hand'eth over the{line+}Masamune!
Message 197 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Mine name is Glenn!{line+}Cyrus's hopes and dreams…{line+}And now the Masamune…
entries.text: {Frog}: إن اسمي غلين!{line}آمال سايرس وأحلامه…{line}والآن ماسامونيه…

entries.context: Message 198 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Forthwith I shall slay{line+}{Magus} and restore honor!
Message 199 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line}A note written in blood!{box}“The Juggler in {Magus}'s castle…{line}strengthens his guard when attacked.{line}Beware!”
entries.text:

entries.text: {Marle}: لقد وصل للتو، فربما هناك شيء يمكننا فعله!{line}لنذهب ونرى!

entries.text: {Lucca}: الآن فهمت!{line}الطاقة الهائلة التي يطلقها لافوس تغير الزمن وتخلق البوابات.

entries.context: Message 322 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: M, mayhap Lavos be the{line+}cause of this warp?{box+}The one in {Magus}'s Castle was{line+}immense.
entries.text:
{Frog}: أ، أيكون لافوس هو علة هذا الصدع في الزمن؟
فلقد كان الصدع الذي في قلعة {Magus} هائلا.

entries.context: Message 323 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Ayla}: What wrong, {Crono}?{line+}Fight Lavos!{line+}Go in here.{line+}Yes?
Message 324 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Marle}: Boy, this is exciting!
Message 325 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: Well it IS the Gate nearest to{line+}Lavos.{line+}We have no idea as to where it leads.
entries.text: {Lucca}: حسنا، إنها بالفعل أقرب بوابة إلى لافوس.{line}ولا ندري إلى أين تؤدي.

entries.context: Message 326 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Robo}: The Time Gyro says…{line+}What!?{line+}12,000 years in the past?!{line+}That was some trip!
entries.text: {Robo}: تشير بوصلة الزمن إلى…{line}ماذا؟!{line}12000 سنة في الماضي؟!{line}يا لها من رحلة!

Message 328 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Ayla}: Where this, {Crono}?!
Message 329 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {line+}       The power is sealed…
Message 330 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): PROPHET: Hmm…so you came in through{line+}here.
entries.text: النبي: همم… إذن دخلتم من هنا.

entries.text: النبي: والآن يا شالا!{line}بعد أن ألقي بهم في البوابة، أريدك أن تختميها بإحكام.

entries.text: شالا: لـ، لا!{line}لا يمكنك أن تجبرني!

Message 334 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): SCHALA: I…oh, all right…

Message 337 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: The Prophet could have just{line+}done away with us.
entries.text: {Lucca}: كان بوسع النبي أن يتخلص منا ببساطة.

entries.text: {Robo}: ما الذي يدعو النبي إلى الإبقاء على حياتنا؟

entries.context: Message 339 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: 'Tis true, he hath spared us.{line+}But something is amiss.
entries.text: {Frog}: لعمري لقد أبقى على حياتنا.{line}غير أن في الأمر ما يريب.

entries.context: Message 340 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: The key to defeating Lavos{line+}must exist in that period.
entries.text: {Lucca}: لا بد أن مفتاح هزيمة لافوس موجود في تلك الحقبة.

entries.context: Message 341 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Robo}: The key to defeating Lavos{line+}must exist in that era.
entries.text: {Robo}: لا بد أن مفتاح هزيمة لافوس موجود في ذلك العصر.

entries.context: Message 342 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Where hast {Magus} gone?{line+}I shan't allow him to get away.
entries.text: {Frog}: ترى أين مضى {Magus}؟{line}لن أدعه يفلت مني.

entries.context: Message 343 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Ayla}: They take energy from{line+}Lavos.{line+}Lavos not get weak?
entries.text: {Ayla}: هم يأخذون طاقة من لافوس.{line}لافوس لا يضعف؟

entries.text: {Marle}: لكننا لا نستطيع العودة إلى ذلك الزمن.{line}ماذا بوسعنا أن نفعل؟

entries.context: Message 345 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: But the Gate to that time has{line+}been sealed.{line+}Is there another way back?
entries.text: {Lucca}: لكن البوابة المؤدية إلى ذلك الزمن أصبحت مختومة.{line}هل من طريق آخر للعودة؟

entries.context: Message 346 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Robo}: But the Gate has been shut.
Message 347 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Yet Schala hast sealed the{line+}Gate.{line+}'Tis not possible to returneth.
entries.text: {Frog}: غير أن شالا قد ختمت البوابة.{line}فما من سبيل إلى العودة.

entries.text: {Marle}: مهلا! الشعار المنقوش على الأبواب التي تفتحها هذه القلادة…{line}لقد رأيته في مكان آخر…

entries.text: {Lucca}: الشعار المنقوش على تلك الأبواب المختومة…{line}لقد رأيناه في مكان آخر، أليس كذلك؟!

entries.context: Message 351 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Robo}: Wait. The crest on the doors{line+}that the pendant opens…{line+}I have seen them in my own time!
entries.text: {Robo}: مهلا. الشعار المنقوش على الأبواب التي تفتحها القلادة…{line}لقد رأيته في زمني أنا!

entries.context: Message 352 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: Thou hast seen elsewhere{line+}the crest on the doors that the{line+}pendant opens, correct?
entries.text: {Frog}: الشعار المنقوش على الأبواب التي تفتحها القلادة…{line}ألم تره في موضع آخر؟

Message 354 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Lucca}: We may yet find our way{line+}back to that era!{line+}Let's get cracking, {Crono}!
entries.text: {Lucca}: ربما ما زال بوسعنا أن نجد طريق العودة إلى ذلك العصر!{line}هيا بنا إلى العمل يا {Crono}!

Message 356 of the fair table (Leene Square and the Millennial Fair...): {Frog}: 'Tis time to depart, eh,{line+}{Crono}?!

entries.text: إذن، هذه هي ذروة قمة الموت!

أنت!{line}هل تسمعني يا {Crono}؟{line}كم تكون مزعجا أحيانا!

I'm Doan.{line+}I'm the descendant of the Director of{line+}this Info center.{box+}In the basement, there's a huge{line+}computer and a storage center for{line+}food.{box+}But we can't get through 'cause of{line+}the robot guards.{line+}It's a pity.

entries.text:

من الجميل أن أرى شبابا بهذه الحماسة، على غير ما اعتدنا.

entries.context: Message 37 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): DOAN: Careful, now.{line+}And come back alive.
Message 38 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): DOAN: Hey fellas!{line+}Look!{line+}The seed's sprouted!
Message 39 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The door with the crest?{line}Dynamite won't budge it.
entries.text: الباب الذي عليه الشعار؟{line}حتى الديناميت لن يزحزحه.

entries.context: Message 40 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): There's an old factory site called Proto{line}Dome to the east. Can't get near it{line}'cause there's a bunch of lunatic robots{line}in the area.
entries.text: إلى الشرق موقع مصنع قديم يدعى قبة بروتو. لا يمكن الاقتراب منه، فالمنطقة تعج بروبوتات مجنونة.

نزل زوجي إلى مخزن الطعام في الأسفل.
ولم أره منذ ذلك الحين…

entries.context: Message 53 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Who are you?
Message 54 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey!{line}It's those people again!
Message 55 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey!{line}It's them!

entries.context: Message 62 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Say, what does this button{line+}do?
Message 63 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: 1999 A.D.?{line+}Visual record of The Day of Lavos…
Message 64 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Wh, what…IS that?
Message 65 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Lavos?…{line+}Is that what's destroying our world?!
Message 66 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: We must truly be in the{line+}future…
entries.text: {Marle}: لا بد أننا في المستقبل حقا…

entries.context: Message 67 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: No!{line+}NO WAY!{line+}I refuse to believe it!!
Message 68 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: This…
Message 69 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: …this can't be the way the{line+}world ends…
Message 70 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: ……
Message 71 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: {Crono}…

entries.text: {Marle}: لم يبق أمامنا إلا شيء واحد!{line}يجب أن نغير التاريخ! تماما كما فعل {Crono} حين أنقذني!

Message 74 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Okay, {Crono}?!!
Message 75 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: I…guess so…

أمركم غريب…{line}أنتم مختلفون عنا…

زوجي… لقد… لقد… رحل…
لكنه ترك لي هدايا ثمينة!{line}البذور… وطفلنا.

entries.text:
العجوز: ألا تعرفون؟{line}هذه «نهاية الزمن» بالطبع!
كل المسافرين الذين يضلون طريقهم في الزمن ينتهي بهم المطاف هنا!{line}والآن، من أين أتيتم؟

entries.context: Message 107 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: We're from{line+}Guardia Kingdom, circa 1000 A.D.
entries.text: {Lucca}: نحن من مملكة غارديا،{line}من عام 1000 م تقريبا.

entries.context: Message 108 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: I come from 2300 A.D…

Message 109 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: When 4 or more beings step{line+}into a time warp, the Conservation{line+}of Time theorem states that they{line+}will turn up…{box+}…at the space-time coordinates of{line+}least resistance.{line+}Here.{box+}Disturbances in the space-time{line+}continuum have increased recently.{line+}Far too many folks are just popping{line+}in here…{box+}I fear something is having a{line+}powerful effect on the very fabric{line+}of time…
entries.text:
العجوز: حين يدخل 4 كائنات أو أكثر إلى صدع زمني، تنص نظرية حفظ الزمن على أنهم سيظهرون…
…عند إحداثيات الزمكان الأقل مقاومة.{line}أي هنا.
ازدادت الاضطرابات في نسيج الزمكان مؤخرا.{line}وصار عدد كبير جدا من الناس يظهرون هنا فجأة…
أخشى أن شيئا ما يؤثر تأثيرا قويا في نسيج الزمن ذاته…

entries.context: Message 110 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Which means one of us has{line+}to remain here.

entries.context: Message 111 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Stay HERE?{line+}ALONE?

Message 112 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: It is pretty bleak here…{box+}But not to worry.{line+}All time periods connect here…{box+}You can visit your friends whenever{line+}you wish! But you can never travel in{line+}groups greater than 3…
entries.text:
العجوز: المكان هنا موحش بعض الشيء…
لكن لا داعي للقلق.{line}فكل العصور تتصل بهذا المكان…
يمكنكم زيارة أصدقائكم متى شئتم! لكن لا يمكنكم أبدا السفر في مجموعات يزيد عددها على 3…

entries.context: Message 113 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: So, one of us must stay.
Message 114 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Who'll it be, {Crono}?
Message 115 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Decide, {Crono}!
Message 116 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Now don't you go getting{line+}any ideas, mister!

entries.text: {Robo}: أرجو أن تأتي لاصطحابي{line}متى احتجت إلي.

entries.text: العجوز: يمكنك أن تضم إلى فريقك فورا أي شخص موجود هنا، إن دعت الحاجة.

entries.context: Message 119 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: …So there you have it.{box+}Don't forget.  Press the Y Button to{line+}switch party members.
entries.text:
العجوز: …هذا كل ما في الأمر.
لا تنس. اضغط زر واي{line}لتبديل أعضاء الفريق.

entries.context: Message 120 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: How do we get back to our{line+}time?

Message 121 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: You see those lovely pillars of{line+}light? Those hook you up to different{line+}eras.{box+}Once you've been through a Gate,{line+}you can always use it to come here.{box+}To use a Gate from here, step into{line+}the light and press the A Button.{line+}But beware the Gate which leads{line+}from that bucket…
entries.text:
العجوز: أترون أعمدة الضوء الجميلة تلك؟ إنها تربطكم بعصور مختلفة.
متى عبرتم بوابة ما، صار بوسعكم دائما استخدامها للمجيء إلى هنا.
لاستخدام بوابة من هنا، ادخلوا في الضوء واضغطوا زر إيه.{line}لكن احذروا البوابة التي في ذلك الدلو…

entries.context: Message 122 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: That Gate leads to 1999 A.D…{line+}It leads to the “Day of Lavos”…{box+}Go there only if you're looking to{line+}achieve a shorter life span…{box+}Lavos will help you leave this mortal{line+}coil.
entries.text:
العجوز: تلك البوابة تؤدي إلى عام 1999 م…{line}إنها تؤدي إلى «يوم لافوس»…
لا تذهبوا إلى هناك إلا إن كنتم ترغبون في تقصير أعماركم…
سيساعدكم لافوس على مفارقة هذه الدنيا الفانية.

entries.context: Message 123 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: Hey.
Message 124 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: Don't be in such a rush!{line+}Before you go, take a peek inside the{line+}room behind me!
entries.text: العجوز: لا تستعجلوا هكذا!{line}قبل أن تذهبوا، ألقوا نظرة داخل الغرفة التي خلفي!

entries.context: Message 125 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's locked shut…

Message 126 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): OLD MAN: Well, well!{line+}People who lived long ago ALL{line+}enjoyed such powers…{box+}Now, I know you are itching to go{line+}ripping back and forth through time,{line+}but first you need to return to your{line+}era.{box+}And you must hurry.{line+}The longer you remain here, the{line+}harder it will be to change that{line+}which must be changed…{box+}Stop by whenever you're in the{line+}area!
entries.text:
العجوز: حسنا، حسنا!{line}كان الناس الذين عاشوا قبل زمن بعيد يتمتعون جميعا بمثل هذه القوى…
والآن، أعلم أنكم تتحرقون شوقا للتنقل ذهابا وإيابا عبر الزمن، لكن عليكم أولا أن تعودوا إلى عصركم.
ويجب أن تسرعوا.{line}فكلما طال بقاؤكم هنا، صار تغيير ما يجب تغييره أصعب…
مروا بي كلما كنتم في الجوار!

Message 161 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: {Epoch} ready{line+}for takeoff!
Message 162 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: High ho, {Epoch}!!
