entries.text:
دخلت الملكة الأسرة المالكة بزواجها قبل 10 سنوات.{line}وما زالت تبدو في ريعان شبابها!
بل إنها تبدو الآن أصغر سنا مما كانت عليه يوم زفافها…

entries.context: Message 806 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): QUEEN: Ah!{line+}There you are.
Message 807 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): QUEEN: Please leave us.{line+}I need to talk to this individual.
entries.text: الملكة: دعننا وحدنا من فضلكن.{line}يجب أن أتحدث إلى هذا الشخص.

entries.context: Message 808 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): ATTENDANTS: Certainly, your Highness.
Message 809 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): QUEEN: Come nearer, Sir.
Message 810 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): QUEEN: Giggle…
Message 811 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): QUEEN: Fooled you, didn't I, {Crono}?
Message 812 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: It's me!{line+}But everyone calls me, Leene!
entries.text: {Marle}: هذه أنا!{line}لكن الجميع هنا ينادونني لين!

entries.context: Message 813 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: I'm so relieved you're here!
Message 814 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: We barely know each other,{line+}but somehow, I knew you'd come for{line+}me…
entries.text: {Marle}: بالكاد نعرف بعضنا،{line}لكنني كنت أعلم بطريقة ما أنك ستأتي من أجلي…

entries.context: Message 815 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Thank you, {Crono}!
Message 816 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: S, something's wrong!!!
Message 817 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: W, what's happening?!{line+}It feels like…I'm being torn apart!
Message 818 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Help me, {Crono}!{line+}I'm scared!!!{line+} Please… {Crono}{line+}…h, help me!
Message 819 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): …{box}I grow so tired of the gossip around{line}here!
entries.text:
…
كم سئمت القيل والقال في هذا المكان!

entries.context: Message 820 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Did you notice anything odd about{line}the Queen?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 821 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Just as I thought!{line}She claims she's not Leene! There's{line}something…different about her.{box}Don't mention this to anyone!
entries.text:
كما ظننت تماما!{line}إنها تزعم أنها ليست لين! ثمة شيء…مختلف فيها.
إياك أن تذكر هذا لأحد!

entries.context: Message 822 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Okay, if you say so.
Message 823 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Has she dismissed you already?{line}You were polite, of course?
entries.text: هل صرفتك بهذه السرعة؟{line}كنت مهذبا معها بالطبع، أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 824 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You didn't do anything…funny, did you?{line+}   Of course not!{line+}   Well…yes.
entries.text: لم تفعل شيئا…غير لائق، أليس كذلك؟{line}{choice}بالطبع لا!{line}{choice}في الواقع…نعم.

entries.context: Message 825 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Are you sure?
Message 826 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oooh! We can't let this juicy tidbit out{line}of the castle!
entries.text: أوووه! لا يمكننا أن ندع هذا الخبر المثير يتسرب خارج القلعة!

entries.context: Message 827 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Go downstairs if you want to rest.
entries.text: انزل إلى الطابق السفلي إن أردت أن تستريح.

entries.context: Message 828 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Knight's quarters is downstairs.
Message 829 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The dining room's below.
Message 830 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's got a nasty temper, so don't{line}get in his way!
entries.text: الطاهي سريع الغضب، فإياك أن تعترض طريقه!

entries.context: Message 831 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): This dining room is for us soldiers.{line}Feel free to grab a bite.
entries.text: قاعة الطعام هذه لنا نحن الجنود.{line}تفضل وتناول لقمة إن شئت.

entries.context: Message 832 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Magus}'s troops had better{line}watch out for us!
Message 833 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's food is great.{line}I give it 3 stars.
Message 834 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I…{box}I'm hungry…
Message 835 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): MAID: Here's your food!
Message 836 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: All right!
Message 837 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): This is great!
Message 838 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hungry? Sit down at the upper left{line}corner of the left table.
entries.text: هل أنت جائع؟ اجلس عند الزاوية العليا اليسرى من الطاولة اليسرى.

entries.context: Message 839 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): This place is a mini war zone!
Message 840 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): This is no place for kids!
Message 841 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Wait! Maybe you'd know!{line}What's this “Eyes Cream” stuff that{line}Queen Leene wants so badly?
entries.text: مهلا! لعلك تعرف!{line}ما هذا الشيء المسمى «كريمة العيون» الذي تريده الملكة لين بشدة؟

entries.context: Message 842 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KNIGHT CAPTAIN: Where's supper?
Message 843 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): WAITRESS: Oh, Captain!{line+}I'm sorry…
Message 844 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KNIGHT CAPTAIN: We're fighting a war{line+}out there!{line+}Can't you even keep us fed?
entries.text: قائد الفرسان: نحن نخوض حربا في الميدان!{line}ألا تستطيعون حتى إطعامنا؟

entries.context: Message 845 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: What are you fussing about?{line+}You're not the only one who's{line+}fighting out there!
entries.text: الطاهي: علام كل هذا التذمر؟{line}لستم وحدكم من يخوض حربا!

entries.context: Message 846 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KNIGHT CAPTAIN: Hey, I don't have time{line+}for this.{line+}Just feed my men, okay?
entries.text: قائد الفرسان: اسمع، لا وقت لدي لهذا.{line}أطعم رجالي فحسب، مفهوم؟

entries.context: Message 847 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: Shut your trap!{line+}I'll decide who's going to get fed,{line+}and when!!
entries.text: الطاهي: أغلق فمك!{line}أنا من يقرر من يأكل، ومتى!!

entries.context: Message 848 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): That fool…he thinks HE'S the boss!
entries.text: ذلك الأحمق… يحسب نفسه الآمر الناهي هنا!

entries.context: Message 849 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Knight Captain is normally very{line}kind.{line}The chef just rubs him the wrong way.
entries.text: قائد الفرسان لطيف جدا في العادة.{line}كل ما في الأمر أن الطاهي يثير أعصابه.

entries.context: Message 850 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Knight Captain is trying hard to fill{line}the shoes of his predecessor, Sir Cyrus,{line}Commander of the Knights.
entries.text: يبذل قائد الفرسان قصارى جهده ليكون على قدر سلفه السير سايرس، قائد الفرسان السابق.

entries.context: Message 851 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Those two are brothers. You've heard{line}the expression, “sibling rivalry,” right?
entries.text: هذان الاثنان أخوان. سمعت بعبارة «تنافس الإخوة»، أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 852 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): My husband chose this life because he's{line}a pacifist.
entries.text: اختار زوجي هذه الحياة لأنه رجل مسالم.

entries.context: Message 853 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Zenan Bridge is our last line of{line}defense!{line}We MUST guard it with our lives!
entries.text: جسر زينان هو خط دفاعنا الأخير!{line}يجب أن نحميه بأرواحنا!

entries.context: Message 854 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): So you're the one who helped the{line}Queen.{line}Talk to the maid if you need to rest.
entries.text: إذن أنت من ساعد الملكة.{line}كلم الخادمة إن احتجت إلى الراحة.

entries.context: Message 855 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Take a snooze?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 856 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Refreshed?
Message 857 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oh!{line}If only Sir Cyrus were here!
Message 858 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You've heard of him, haven't you?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
Message 859 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): If HE were here, this whole mess with{line}the Queen would never have happened.
entries.text: لو كان هو هنا، لما وقعت ورطة الملكة هذه من الأساس.

entries.context: Message 860 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You don't know of Sir Cyrus?!{line}From which land do you come?{line}Or are you simply a fool?
entries.text: لا تعرف السير سايرس؟!{line}من أي أرض جئت؟{line}أم أنك مجرد أحمق؟

entries.context: Message 861 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Sir Cyrus was the Commander of the{line}Knights. His mission was to protect the{line}King and Queen.{box}He and a friend left on a journey 10{line}years ago.{line}No one has heard from them since.
entries.text:
كان السير سايرس قائد الفرسان، وكانت مهمته حماية الملك والملكة.
انطلق في رحلة مع صديق له قبل 10 سنوات،{line}ولم يسمع عنهما أحد شيئا منذ ذلك الحين.

entries.context: Message 862 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Long ago, a beast called Yakra lurked in{line}the western forest. But after the{line}cathedral was built, Yakra disappeared.{line}We're thankful for that.
entries.text: منذ زمن بعيد، كان وحش يدعى ياكرا يتربص في الغابة الغربية. لكن بعد بناء الكاتدرائية، اختفى ياكرا.{line}ونحن ممتنون لذلك.

entries.context: Message 863 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): What a relief, the Queen's been found.{line}Now we can concentrate on the war!
entries.text: يا للارتياح! لقد عثروا على الملكة.{line}الآن يمكننا أن نتفرغ للحرب!

entries.context: Message 864 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oooohhh…
Message 865 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Magus}'s troops are strangely{line}quiet…{line}Something's about to happen.
entries.text: جيش {Magus} هادئ على نحو غريب…{line}شيء ما على وشك أن يحدث.

entries.context: Message 866 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Just between us, the Chancellor's been{line}acting VERY strange lately.{line}He's been sneakin' out at night…
entries.text: بيني وبينك، المستشار يتصرف بغرابة شديدة مؤخرا.{line}صار يتسلل إلى الخارج ليلا…

entries.context: Message 867 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Speaking of nut cases, I haven't seen{line}the Queen's guard, that frog-thing,{line}recently.{box}Heard a spell turned him into a frog.{line}Do you believe that?{line} I think he's a spy!
entries.text:
وبالحديث عن المجانين، لم أر حارس الملكة، ذلك المخلوق الضفدعي، منذ مدة.
سمعت أن تعويذة حولته إلى ضفدع.{line}أتصدق ذلك؟{line}أظنه جاسوسا!

entries.context: Message 868 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): People say the Chancellor's gone crazy,{line}but I don't believe it.{box}The Chancellor's a decent man.{line}Why, he goes to the cathedral{line}everyday.
entries.text:
يقول الناس إن المستشار فقد عقله،{line}لكنني لا أصدق ذلك.
المستشار رجل صالح.{line}بل إنه يذهب إلى الكاتدرائية{line}كل يوم.

entries.context: Message 869 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Crono}!
Message 870 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}:  Huff, puff…you're okay!{line+}Did you find the girl?
entries.text: {Lucca}: هاه… هاه… أنت بخير!{line}هل وجدت الفتاة؟

entries.context: Message 871 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: GONE?!{line+}Whadd'ya mean she's gone?!
Message 872 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Hmm…it's just as I thought.
Message 873 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: I knew I recognized her!
Message 874 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: And this looks identical to{line+}the castle in OUR time!
entries.text: {Lucca}: وهذا المكان مطابق تماما{line}للقلعة في زماننا نحن!

entries.context: Message 875 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: I'll bet they mistook{line+}that girl for her ancestor…{line+}You see, she's a member of the royal{line+}family in OUR time!
entries.text: {Lucca}: أراهن أنهم خلطوا بين تلك الفتاة{line}وسلفها…{line}فهي في الحقيقة من الأسرة المالكة{line}في زماننا نحن!

entries.context: Message 876 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: She's Princess {Nadia}!

Message 877 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Something must have{line+}happened to the Queen in this era.{line+}As a result, Princess  {Nadia}{line+}ceases to exists!
entries.text: {Lucca}: لا بد أن أمرا ما قد أصاب{line}الملكة في هذا العصر.{line}ونتيجة لذلك، زالت الأميرة ناديا{line}من الوجود!

entries.context: Message 878 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Hurry!{line+}We have to find the real Queen!
Message 879 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING GUARDIA: You had me worried,{line+}Leene.
entries.text: الملك غارديا: لقد أقلقتني عليك{line}يا لين.

entries.context: Message 880 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: I failed to protect{line+}Queen Leene.{line+}I hath disgraced thee.
entries.text: {Frog}: إني أخفقت في حماية{line}الملكة لين،{line}فألحقت بك العار.

entries.context: Message 881 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): LEENE: {Frog}!

Message 882 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): LEENE: Your timing was perfect.{line+}Who knows what would have{line+}happened had you not saved me!{box+}By the way, where is the girl who{line+}was mistaken for me?
entries.text:
لين: لقد جئت في الوقت المناسب تماما.{line}من يدري ما كان سيحدث{line}لو لم تنقذني!
بالمناسبة، أين الفتاة التي{line}ظنوا أنها أنا؟

entries.context: Message 883 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Oh, yeah!{line+}I forgot all about Princess {Nadia}!
entries.text: {Lucca}: آه، صحيح!{line}نسيت أمر الأميرة ناديا تماما!

entries.context: Message 884 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: {Crono}!{line+}Where did Princess {Nadia}{line+}disappear?{line+}She may still be there!
entries.text: {Lucca}: {Crono}!{line}أين اختفت الأميرة ناديا؟{line}ربما لا تزال هناك!

entries.context: Message 885 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Princess {Nadia}!
Message 886 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Huh?{line+}What happened?
Message 887 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: {Crono}!

Message 888 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: It was awful…{box+}I can't recall it all…{line+}I was somewhere cold, dark…and{line+}lonely.{box+}Is that what it's like to…die?
entries.text:
{Marle}: كان الأمر مروعا…
لا أستطيع أن أتذكر كل شيء…{line}كنت في مكان بارد ومظلم… وكنت وحيدة.
أهذا ما يشعر به المرء حين… يموت؟

entries.context: Message 889 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Welcome back, Princess{line+}{Nadia}!
Message 890 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: You risked your life to{line+}help me, too?!{line+}“Princess…{Nadia}…?!”{box+}Uh oh…
entries.text:
{Marle}: أنت أيضا خاطرت بحياتك لإنقاذي؟!{line}«الأميرة… ناديا…؟!»
أوه، لا…

entries.context: Message 891 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: I guess you guys figured it{line+}out, huh?
Message 892 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Sorry, {Crono}.{line+}I didn't mean to deceive you.

Message 893 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: I'm Princess {Nadia}.{line+}My father's King Guardia the XXXIII.{box+}I really enjoyed being with you at{line+}the fair.{line+}But if you had known my identity…
entries.text:
{Marle}: أنا الأميرة ناديا.{line}وأبي هو الملك غارديا الثالث والثلاثون.
لقد استمتعت حقا بصحبتك في المهرجان.{line}لكن لو كنت تعرف من أكون…

entries.context: Message 894 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: {Crono}, you wouldn't have{line+}shown me around the fair, right!{line+}   Right.{line+}   Wrong!
entries.text: {Marle}: ما كنت لتتجول معي في المهرجان{line}يا {Crono}، أليس كذلك؟{line}{choice}صحيح.{line}{choice}غير صحيح!

entries.context: Message 895 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: See?{line+}I like {Marle} better than{line+}“Princess,” anyway!
entries.text: {Marle}: أرأيت؟{line}على أي حال، أنا أحب اسم {Marle}{line}أكثر من لقب «الأميرة»!

entries.context: Message 896 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Oh, {Crono}!{line+}That's why I like you!
Message 897 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: The real Queen's safe, right?{line+}So let's go home, {Crono}!
entries.text: {Marle}: الملكة الحقيقية بخير، أليس كذلك؟{line}إذن لنعد إلى الديار يا {Crono}!

entries.context: Message 898 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: That no good Yakra!{line+}Impersonating me and kidnapping{line+}the Queen!{box+}We MUST create a criminal justice{line+}system in this Kingdom to do away{line+}with such fiends.
entries.text:
المستشار: ياكرا، ذلك الوغد الحقير!{line}تجرأ على انتحال شخصيتي واختطاف الملكة!
علينا حتما أن ننشئ في هذه المملكة نظاما للقضاء الجنائي، لنتخلص من أمثال هؤلاء الأشرار.

entries.context: Message 899 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Wow, you could be Leene's twin!
entries.text: يا للعجب، تبدين كأنك توأم لين!

entries.context: Message 900 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Thank you, {Crono}.{line}But…who was that girl we found in the{line}canyon?
entries.text: شكرا لك يا {Crono}.{line}لكن… من تكون تلك الفتاة التي وجدناها في الوادي؟

entries.context: Message 901 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Thank goodness, you're safe!!{line}You may resemble Leene, but you sure{line}don't act like her!{box}Anyway, you've really helped me.{line}Let me know how I can repay you.
entries.text:
الحمد لله على سلامتك!!{line}قد تشبهين لين، لكنك بالتأكيد لا تتصرفين مثلها!
على أي حال، لقد ساعدتني كثيرا.{line}أخبريني كيف يمكنني أن أرد لك الجميل.

entries.context: Message 902 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: You're the real Queen Leene,{line+}huh?!
Message 903 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): LEENE: You really could be my twin.
Message 904 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Well, you two better get{line+}along…{line+}or I'll be in big trouble.{box+}I'll keep my fingers crossed!
entries.text:
{Marle}: حسنا، من الأفضل لكما أن تتفاهما…{line}وإلا وقعت أنا في ورطة كبيرة.
سأدعو أن يسير كل شيء على ما يرام!

entries.context: Message 905 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): LEENE: Excuse me?
Message 906 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Um…never mind!{line+}I guess it's time to go!
entries.text: {Marle}: أمم… لا عليك!{line}أظن أن وقت الرحيل قد حان!

entries.context: Message 907 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You seem like one of the family, now!
entries.text: تبدو الآن كأنك فرد من العائلة!

entries.context: Message 908 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: 'Twas a fault of mine, which{line+}endangered the Queen.{box+}I shall depart for good.
entries.text:
{Frog}: لقد كان تقصيري هو ما عرض{line}الملكة للخطر.
إني راحل بلا رجعة.

entries.context: Message 909 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Eeeek!
Message 910 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Indeed, your resemblance{line+}to the Queen is uncanny.
Message 911 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: {Crono}, you hath potential{line+}to be a good swordsman!
entries.text: {Frog}: يا {Crono}، إن فيك ما يؤهلك{line}لتكون سيافا بارعا!

entries.context: Message 912 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: …{box+}Froggy, you weren't such a bad guy{line+}either.
entries.text:
{Lucca}: …
وأنت أيضا يا ضفيدع،{line}لم تكن سيئا إلى هذا الحد.

entries.context: Message 913 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Hello!{line+}You're always welcome here.{line+}What can I do for you?
entries.text: الملك: أهلا بكم!{line}أبوابنا مفتوحة لكم دائما.{line}ماذا بوسعي أن أفعل لكم؟

entries.context: Message 914 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Well…
Message 915 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Um, well, it's…
Message 916 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: We would like to ask a{line+}favor…
Message 917 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: We asketh a favor…
Message 918 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Ayla}: {Ayla} have favor.
Message 919 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: I get it. You want me to keep{line+}that huge shell safe here until the{line+}next century, right?
entries.text: الملك: فهمت. تريدون أن أحفظ تلك الصدفة{line}الضخمة هنا في أمان لقرون قادمة،{line}أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 920 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): LEENE: I ask for the sake of {member 1}.{line+}Please carry out their request.
entries.text: لين: أطلب ذلك من أجل {member 1}.{line}أرجو أن تلبي طلبهم.

entries.context: Message 921 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Done!{line+}I shall obtain the shell and store it in{line+}the castle, as a national treasure.
entries.text: الملك: لكم ذلك!{line}سأجلب الصدفة وأحفظها في القلعة{line}كنزا وطنيا.

entries.context: Message 922 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Knight Captain!
Message 923 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KNIGHT CAPTAIN: Yes, Majesty!
entries.text: قائد الفرسان: أمرك يا صاحب الجلالة!

entries.context: Message 924 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Go and obtain the Rainbow Shell,{line+}and bring it back in one piece!
entries.text: الملك: انطلق في طلب الصدفة القزحية،{line}وعد بها سليمة تماما!

entries.context: Message 925 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KNIGHT CAPTAIN: At once, Sire!
entries.text: قائد الفرسان: في الحال يا مولاي!

entries.context: Message 926 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Thank you, your Majesty!{line+}And Queen Leene too, of course!
entries.text: {Marle}: شكرا لك يا صاحب الجلالة!{line}وأشكر الملكة لين أيضا بالطبع!

entries.context: Message 927 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Thank you very much!
Message 928 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: Thank you very much!
Message 929 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Thanks to thee, from one so{line+}humble.
entries.text: {Frog}: لك مني جزيل الشكر،{line}وإن كان من امرئ متواضع الشأن مثلي.

entries.context: Message 930 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Ayla}: You, good man!{line+}Strong!{line+}{Ayla} like!
Message 931 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: Oh, it's you again.
Message 932 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Magus}'s troops had us cornered{line}but the appearance of the Hero, saved{line}us.
entries.text: كان جيش {Magus} قد حاصرنا، لكن ظهور البطل أنقذنا.

entries.context: Message 933 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hero?{line}He just went to see the King a moment{line}ago.
entries.text: البطل؟{line}لقد ذهب لمقابلة الملك قبل لحظات.

entries.context: Message 934 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Sir {Crono}!{line}The legendary Hero has finally{line}appeared!{box}He just arrived a moment ago, to meet{line}the King.
entries.text:
أيها السير {Crono}!{line}لقد ظهر البطل الأسطوري أخيرا!
وصل قبل لحظات فقط ليقابل الملك.

entries.context: Message 935 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King was injured, and is{line}recuperating in bed.
entries.text: أصيب الملك، وهو الآن يتعافى في فراشه.

entries.context: Message 936 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Queen Leene has been at his side all{line}night.
entries.text: ظلت الملكة لين إلى جانبه طوال الليل.

entries.context: Message 937 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King fought bravely against{line}{Magus}'s troops. Had he not heard of{line}the arrival of the Hero, he might have{line}fought to the death!
entries.text: قاتل الملك جيش {Magus} ببسالة. ولولا أنه سمع بوصول البطل، لربما ظل يقاتل حتى الموت!

entries.context: Message 938 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm so ashamed…{box}I treated him badly, thinking he was{line}just some brat.{box}Luckily, he forgave me.{line}A hero, HE IS.
entries.text:
أشعر بخجل شديد…
أسأت معاملته، ظنا مني أنه مجرد ولد شقي.
لحسن الحظ، سامحني.{line}إنه بطل حقا وصدقا.

entries.context: Message 939 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): At this rate, Queen Leene will also{line}succumb.
entries.text: إن استمر الحال على هذا المنوال، فستنهار الملكة لين هي الأخرى.

entries.context: Message 940 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oh, {Crono}…{line}I've let down my kingdom.{box}Since we cannot locate Cyrus, our sole{line}hope rests on the boy who has the{line}hero medal…{box}He searches the southern continent,{line}for the sword that can defeat{line}{Magus}.
entries.text:
آه يا {Crono}…{line}لقد خذلت مملكتي.
وما دمنا عاجزين عن العثور على سايرس، فأملنا الوحيد معقود على الفتى الذي يحمل ميدالية البطل…
إنه يجوب القارة الجنوبية بحثا عن السيف القادر على هزيمة {Magus}.

entries.context: Message 941 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Cyrus must have sent the boy to us.
entries.text: لا بد أن سايرس هو من أرسل إلينا هذا الفتى.

entries.context: Message 942 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Knight Captain has gone to Zenan{line}Bridge. Many of the wounded from{line}there, are resting below.
entries.text: ذهب قائد الفرسان إلى جسر زينان. وكثير من الجرحى القادمين من هناك يرقدون في الطابق السفلي.

entries.context: Message 943 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's in a snit, trying to get food{line}to the front lines while keeping the{line}King healthy.
entries.text: الطاهي في مزاج عكر، فهو يحاول إيصال الطعام إلى الجبهة، ويحرص في الوقت نفسه على صحة الملك.

entries.context: Message 944 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm sorry, the beds are all taken.
entries.text: عذرا، لم يعد هناك سرير شاغر.

entries.context: Message 945 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Even the Knight Captain went to the{line}front lines…
entries.text: حتى قائد الفرسان ذهب إلى الجبهة…

entries.context: Message 946 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Magus} has already defeated 3{line}fierce warriors.
entries.text: لقد هزم {Magus} حتى الآن 3 محاربين أشداء.

entries.context: Message 947 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): There's a food shortage on the front{line}lines.
entries.text: هناك نقص في الطعام على الجبهة.

entries.context: Message 948 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Heard something 'bout a hero showing{line}up.
entries.text: سمعت كلاما عن ظهور بطل ما.

entries.context: Message 949 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Argh…
Message 950 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King's trying his best, too.{line}So snap out of it!
entries.text: الملك أيضا يبذل قصارى جهده.{line}فتماسك إذن!

entries.context: Message 951 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The wounded just keep piling up.
entries.text: عدد الجرحى لا يكف عن الازدياد.

entries.context: Message 952 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey, hey, come on now!!
Message 953 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey you, is this food good enough for{line}the King?
entries.text: أنت! هل هذا الطعام لائق بالملك؟

entries.context: Message 954 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Chef, hurry with the food that goes to{line}Zenan Bridge!
entries.text: أسرع أيها الطاهي بالطعام المخصص لجسر زينان!

entries.context: Message 955 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: What?{line+}My brother?!{line+}He's…
Message 956 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: That's what you get for thinkin'{line+}that you're the only ones fighting for{line+}your country!
entries.text: الطاهي: هذا جزاؤكم لأنكم ظننتم أنكم وحدكم من يقاتل في سبيل الوطن!

entries.context: Message 957 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): MAID: Hey!
Message 958 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): MAID: Stop bickering!{line+}Grow up!
entries.text: الخادمة: كف عن هذه المشاحنات!{line}تصرف كالكبار!

entries.context: Message 959 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: …{box+}Pipe down!{line+}What do you know?!
Message 960 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Men are such fools!
Message 961 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): He acts that way, but the chef always{line}worries about the Knight Captain.
entries.text: قد يتصرف هكذا، لكن الطاهي لا يكف عن القلق على قائد الفرسان.

entries.context: Message 962 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Wait!
Message 963 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: …{box+}Take this with you!
Message 964 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: And tell that fool…{box+}He had better come back alive!
entries.text:
الطاهي: وقل لذلك الأحمق…
عليه أن يعود حيا!

entries.context: Message 965 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You can come and go as you please{line}from now on.
entries.text: يمكنك أن تدخل وتخرج كما تشاء من الآن فصاعدا.

entries.context: Message 966 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You sure were lucky, defeating Yakra{line}and all.
entries.text: لقد حالفك الحظ حقا حين هزمت ياكرا.

entries.context: Message 967 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): This ought to relieve the King.
entries.text: من شأن هذا أن يطمئن الملك.

entries.context: Message 968 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Leene's presence always brightens{line}things up.
entries.text: حضور لين يبعث البهجة في المكان دائما.

entries.context: Message 969 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King and Queen make such a great{line}couple!
Message 970 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): So… she wasn't Leene after all.
entries.text: إذن… لم تكن هي لين في الحقيقة.

entries.context: Message 971 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Which means the real Leene was{line}somewhere else.{line}It's exactly as I thought.
entries.text: وهذا يعني أن لين الحقيقية كانت في مكان آخر.{line}تماما كما ظننت.

entries.context: Message 972 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): But you're a dead ringer for her.
Message 973 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hmmm.  The more I look at you, the{line}stronger the resemblance…uncanny!
entries.text: همم. كلما أطلت النظر إليك، ازداد الشبه وضوحا… يا للعجب!

entries.context: Message 974 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You guys leaving?{line}Wherever you're heading, be careful!
entries.text: هل ستغادرون؟{line}أينما كانت وجهتكم، توخوا الحذر!

entries.context: Message 975 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The REAL Leene?{line}Wonderful!{line}Let's prepare a feast!

Message 976 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): What?!{line}That wasn't Queen Leene?!{box}And I wasted my time whipping up a{line}batch of that “Eyes Cream” dish she{line}wanted so badly!{line}Yuck!
entries.text:
ماذا؟!{line}تلك لم تكن الملكة لين؟!
وكم أضعت من وقتي في تحضير طبق «كريمة العيون» ذاك الذي كانت تريده بشدة!{line}يا للقرف!

entries.context: Message 977 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Now the Knight Captain can{line}concentrate on battling {Magus}'s{line}troops.
entries.text: الآن يستطيع قائد الفرسان أن يتفرغ لقتال جيش {Magus}.

entries.context: Message 978 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hard to believe she really wasn't{line}Leene…
entries.text: يصعب علي أن أصدق أنها لم تكن لين حقا…

entries.context: Message 979 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Well, Leene would never snack before{line}meals like that other girl did!
entries.text: في الحقيقة، لين لا تأكل أبدا قبل موعد الطعام، على عكس تلك الفتاة الأخرى!

entries.context: Message 980 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): So! That cathedral was at the heart of{line}it all.{line}That {Frog}'s done a fine job.{box}But since {Magus}'s troops failed to{line}kidnap Leene, they'll probably be back{line}soon.{line}If only Cyrus were here!
entries.text:
إذن! تلك الكاتدرائية كانت وراء كل ما جرى.{line}لقد أبلى {Frog} بلاء حسنا.
لكن بما أن جيش {Magus} فشل في اختطاف لين، فالأرجح أنهم سيعودون قريبا.{line}ليت سايرس كان هنا!

entries.context: Message 981 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We must crush {Magus}'s troops!
Message 982 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Heard that {Magus}'s troops put{line}Yakra up to it all.
entries.text: سمعت أن جيش {Magus} هو من دفع ياكرا إلى فعل كل ذلك.

entries.context: Message 983 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Can't believe the cathedral was  their{line}hideout.
entries.text: لا أصدق أن الكاتدرائية كانت مخبأهم.

entries.context: Message 984 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I guess {Magus}'s troops kidnapped{line}Leene.
entries.text: أظن أن جيش {Magus} هو من اختطف لين.

entries.context: Message 985 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Didn't know that a frog could be so{line}brave.
entries.text: لم أكن أعلم أن ضفدعا قد يكون بهذه الشجاعة.

entries.context: Message 986 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hmm. I still think there's a conspiracy{line}going on here!
entries.text: همم. ما زلت أظن أن ثمة مؤامرة تحاك هنا!

entries.context: Message 987 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): A beast was posing as the Chancellor?{line}Well, the fake one had much better{line}taste.
entries.text: أكان وحش ينتحل شخصية المستشار؟{line}والحق يقال، كان ذوق المزيف أرقى بكثير.

entries.context: Message 988 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): What will you have?{line+}   Refresh Salad{line+}   Power Stew{line+}   Hyper Kabob
Message 989 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Just a sec, okay?
Message 990 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Here you go!
Message 991 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}             MP recovered!
Message 992 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}             HP recovered!
Message 993 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}          HP/MP recovered!
Message 994 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's stubborn, but he's a good{line}man.
Message 995 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): So!{line}YOU saved Queen Leene!
entries.text: هكذا إذن!{line}أنت من أنقذ الملكة لين!

entries.context: Message 996 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I THOUGHT she ate too much to be our{line}Queen.
entries.text: كنت أشك في أمرها!{line}فقد كانت تأكل أكثر مما يليق بملكتنا.

entries.context: Message 997 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Those two are really looking for a way{line}to make up.
entries.text: هذان الاثنان يبحثان حقا عن سبيل للتصالح.

entries.context: Message 998 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We've got to nurse the King back to{line}good health!
entries.text: علينا أن نعتني بالملك حتى يستعيد عافيته!

entries.context: Message 999 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Sorry, I don't have time right now.

Message 1000 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Yo!{box}What?{line}You want some Jerky?{box}Sorry, I'm out of the ingredients right{line}now. Besides, it's a tad spicy for most{line}people.
entries.text:
أهلا!
ماذا؟{line}تريد بعض اللحم المجفف؟
آسف، نفدت مني مكوناته الآن. ثم إنه حار قليلا على ذوق معظم الناس.

entries.context: Message 1001 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Y…you're ALIVE!{box}Although we did sustain major{line}casualties, we wouldn't have made it{line}without you!{box}Anyway, we all must work together to{line}rebuild the Kingdom of Guardia!{box}We're all in this together!
entries.text:
أ… أنتم على قيد الحياة!
صحيح أننا تكبدنا خسائر فادحة، لكننا ما كنا لننجو لولاكم!
على أي حال، علينا جميعا أن نتكاتف لنعيد بناء مملكة غارديا!
كلنا في مركب واحد!

entries.context: Message 1002 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}!{box}So, you've teamed up with {Crono}{line}and the others!{box}You've done a fine job.{line}Please remain with us as long as you{line}wish.
entries.text:
{Frog}!
إذن فقد انضممت إلى {Crono} ورفاقه!
لقد أحسنت صنعا.{line}أرجو أن تبقى بيننا ما طاب لك المقام.

entries.context: Message 1003 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Crono}, my thanks extend for{line}generations to come.
entries.text: يا {Crono}، سيدوم امتناني لك جيلا بعد جيل.

entries.context: Message 1004 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Nonesense!{line}YOU saved the day.{line}I just cooked!{box}I'm whipping up a victory meal!{line}Something real fancy!
entries.text:
ما هذا الكلام!{line}أنت من أنقذ الموقف.{line}أما أنا فلم أفعل سوى الطبخ!
سأعد وليمة احتفالا بالنصر!{line}وليمة فاخرة بحق!

entries.context: Message 1005 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We destroyed {Magus}'s troops and{line}we owe it all to {Crono}.
entries.text: لقد سحقنا جيش {Magus}، والفضل كله يعود إلى {Crono}.

entries.context: Message 1006 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}, you're magnificent…!{box}I knew you'd do it…{line}I was thinking 'bout making you{line}“Knight Captain!”
entries.text:
يا {Frog}، لقد كنت عظيما…!
كنت أعلم أنك ستنجح…{line}كنت أفكر في أن أجعلك{line}«قائد الفرسان»!

entries.context: Message 1007 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: I'm afraid 'tis not for me…
Message 1008 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: …{box+}My heart is glad…thank you,{line+}my Liege!
entries.text:
{Frog}: …
إن قلبي لمسرور… لك جزيل الشكر{line}يا مولاي!

entries.context: Message 1009 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I don't know how to thank you…{box}{Frog}!{line}Where's {Frog}?
Message 1010 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We've been expecting you!{line}To the King's chamber, please!
entries.text: كنا في انتظاركم!{line}تفضلوا إلى غرفة الملك!

entries.context: Message 1011 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): What a stroke of luck for you guys.{line}Defeated {Magus}, huh?
entries.text: لقد حالفكم الحظ حقا.{line}هزمتم {Magus}، أليس كذلك؟

entries.context: Message 1012 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Since you didn't come out of{line}{Magus}'s castle, I simply thought…
entries.text: بما أنكم لم تخرجوا من قلعة {Magus}، ظننت أنكم قد…

entries.context: Message 1013 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): If they had broken through at Zenan{line}Bridge, this castle would've been{line}destroyed.
entries.text: لو أنهم اخترقوا صفوفنا عند جسر زينان، لكانت هذه القلعة قد دمرت.

entries.context: Message 1014 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The injured soldiers have all{line}recovered.
Message 1015 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): See, they're all better!
Message 1016 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Please…be{box}…gentle…
Message 1017 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I was one of the people you saved at{line}Zenan.
entries.text: كنت واحدا ممن أنقذتهم في زينان.

entries.context: Message 1018 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm sure Cyrus is smiling, wherever he{line}is.
entries.text: لا بد أن سايرس يبتسم الآن، أينما كان.

entries.context: Message 1019 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's experimenting on a great{line}dish.
entries.text: الطاهي منهمك في تجربة طبق عظيم.

entries.context: Message 1020 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's so complicated, who knows when{line}he'll be done!
entries.text: إنه معقد جدا، ولا أحد يعلم متى سينتهي منه!

entries.context: Message 1021 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): A great dish needs a great name!
entries.text: الطبق العظيم يحتاج إلى اسم عظيم!

entries.context: Message 1022 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Knight Captain and chef have{line}finally made up!
entries.text: لقد تصالح قائد الفرسان والطاهي أخيرا!

entries.context: Message 1023 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}, thanks again.{line}You deserve the title, Knight!
entries.text: يا {Frog}، شكرا لك مرة أخرى.{line}أنت تستحق لقب فارس!

entries.context: Message 1024 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Waste not, such precious{line+}words on me.
entries.text: {Frog}: لا تبدد مثل هذا الكلام النفيس{line}على مثلي.

entries.context: Message 1025 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHEF: And, this is for you guys.{line+}Take it, will ya.
entries.text: الطاهي: وهذا لكم يا رفاق.{line}هيا، خذوه.

entries.context: Message 1026 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}Sealed with a mysterious energy…
Message 1027 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Something inside is reacting to the{line}pendant. Take out what's inside?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: شيء ما في الداخل يتفاعل مع القلادة.{line}أتخرج ما بداخله؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 1028 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}            Got 1 {item}!
Message 1029 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: Who's there!
Message 1030 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: Can't let you through.{line+}Go check out the festival!
entries.text: الجندي: لا يمكنني السماح لك بالمرور.{line}اذهب واستمتع بالمهرجان!

entries.context: Message 1031 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Princess {Nadia}!

Message 1032 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Are you all right?{line+}Where have you been?!{box+}I heard you were abducted!{line+}We had soldiers searching for you!
entries.text:
المستشار: هل أنت بخير؟{line}أين كنت؟!
بلغني أنك تعرضت للاختطاف!{line}لقد أرسلنا الجنود للبحث عنك!

entries.context: Message 1033 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Scoundrel!{line+}You're the one, huh?{line+}Kidnapping Princess {Nadia}!
entries.text: المستشار: أيها الوغد!{line}إذن أنت الفاعل!{line}أنت من اختطف الأميرة ناديا!

entries.context: Message 1034 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: No!{line+}{Crono}'s…
Message 1035 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Admit it!{line+}You confused her and tried to take{line+}over the throne!{line+}Terrorist!!
entries.text: المستشار: اعترف!{line}لقد غررت بها وحاولت الاستيلاء على العرش!{line}أيها الإرهابي!!

entries.context: Message 1036 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: S, stop it!
Message 1037 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Stop this at once!!
Message 1038 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: What are you doing!
Message 1039 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: But Princess {Nadia} said{line+}to…
Message 1040 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Idiots!{line+}Detain him!!
Message 1041 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: {Crono}!!
Message 1042 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): They're escaping!
Message 1043 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: This doesn't look good!
Message 1044 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: We have no choice but to{line+}break through!
entries.text: {Lucca}: لا خيار أمامنا سوى أن نشق طريقنا بالقوة!

entries.context: Message 1045 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Stop!
Message 1046 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: Princess {Nadia}!
Message 1047 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: This is my friend!{line+}Show him your respect!
Message 1048 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: B, but…
Message 1049 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Can't you take orders?
Message 1050 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: Of course!
Message 1051 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hold it right there!
Message 1052 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Do as King Guardia XXXIII{line+}says!
entries.text: المستشار: نفذوا ما يأمر به جلالة الملك غارديا الثالث والثلاثين!

entries.context: Message 1053 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Father…
Message 1054 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Silence, Princess {Nadia}!{box+}The throne comes before your{line+}personal wishes!
entries.text:
الملك: اصمتي أيتها الأميرة ناديا!
العرش مقدم على رغباتك الشخصية!

entries.context: Message 1055 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: What!?{line+}Just because I have a title doesn't{line+}mean I'm not a person!
entries.text: {Marle}: ماذا؟!{line}كوني أحمل لقبا لا يعني أنني لست إنسانة!

entries.context: Message 1056 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: You pick up strange ideas{line+}venturing outside!
entries.text: الملك: لقد التقطت أفكارا غريبة من تجوالك خارج القلعة!

entries.context: Message 1057 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: I didn't “pick up” anything!{line+}It's called “common sense!”
Message 1058 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Princess {Nadia}!
Message 1059 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: I despise you!{line+}I'm leaving!
Message 1060 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Princess {Nadia}!
Message 1061 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Come on, {Crono}!!
Message 1062 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Don't just stand there!{line+}After them!
entries.text: المستشار: لا تقفوا مكتوفي الأيدي!{line}الحقوا بهم!

entries.context: Message 1063 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Princess {Nadia}…
Message 1064 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): You're not going anywhere!
Message 1065 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's locked tight…
Message 1066 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Come on, {Crono}!{line+}I don't wanna see that bullheaded{line+}fool!
entries.text: {Marle}: هيا بنا يا {Crono}!{line}لا أريد أن أرى ذلك الأحمق العنيد!

entries.context: Message 1067 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SOLDIER: !!{box+}T, Terrorists!!
Message 1068 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: This is NOT good.
Message 1069 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: What is going on?!
Message 1070 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Who, what?{line+}Terrorists?!

Message 1071 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: I've been worried,{line+}Princess!{box+}I understand your pain.{line+}But the king really only cares about{line+}his realm…{box+}Yes, even when your mother, Queen{line+}Aliza passed away, he worked all{line+}day!
entries.text:
المستشار: لكم قلقت عليك يا سمو الأميرة!
إنني أتفهم ألمك.{line}لكن الملك، في الحقيقة، لا يهمه سوى مملكته…
أجل، حتى حين توفيت والدتك، الملكة أليزا، ظل يعمل طوال اليوم!

entries.context: Message 1072 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: No one could do that!{line+}It's inhuman!
entries.text: {Marle}: لا يعقل أن يفعل أحد هذا!{line}هذا ليس من الإنسانية في شيء!

entries.context: Message 1073 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Oh, child, it's ancient{line+}history now…
entries.text: المستشار: آه يا صغيرتي، لقد صار ذلك من الماضي البعيد…

entries.context: Message 1074 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Tell me more!

Message 1075 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: This may be difficult…{box+}Well, Queen Aliza's condition suddenly{line+}changed for the worst.{box+}She desperately wanted to see the{line+}king one last time, but he couldn't{line+}find the time to drop by…
entries.text:
المستشار: قد يصعب عليك سماع هذا…
حسنا، لقد ساءت حالة الملكة أليزا فجأة.
كانت تتوق بشدة إلى رؤية الملك مرة أخيرة، لكنه لم يجد وقتا ليمر بها…

entries.context: Message 1076 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Said he had some work to{line+}do…{box+}But knowing nothing about death,{line+}you waited faithfully by your{line+}mother's side…
entries.text:
المستشار: قال إن لديه أعمالا عليه إنجازها…
أما أنت، ولم تكوني تعرفين شيئا عن الموت، فقد بقيت إلى جوار أمك بكل وفاء…

entries.context: Message 1077 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Aliza passed away in{line+}sorrow…{box+}It's as if the king indirectly killed{line+}her… Such a shame…
entries.text:
المستشار: ورحلت أليزا والحزن يملأ قلبها…
وكأن الملك هو من قتلها، وإن لم يكن ذلك بيده… يا للأسف…

entries.context: Message 1078 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: WHAT…!!{box+}Father KILLED?{line+}…MY MOTHER…?!!
Message 1079 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: But what do I know!{line+}There are reasons for everything,{line+}right dear?
entries.text: المستشار: لكن ما أدراني أنا!{line}لكل شيء أسبابه، أليس كذلك يا عزيزتي؟

entries.context: Message 1080 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Now…so glad to see you{line+}back again.{line+}Please go and visit the king.
entries.text: المستشار: والآن… كم يسعدني أن أراك وقد عدت إلينا.{line}تفضلي بزيارة جلالة الملك.

entries.context: Message 1081 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Oh!{line+}{Nadia}…
Message 1082 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: W, what do you want!{line+}I'm not giving in to your demands!
entries.text: الملك: م، ماذا تريدين؟!{line}لن أرضخ لمطالبك!

entries.context: Message 1083 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: ……

Message 1084 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: It's your fault for leaving the{line+}castle!{box+}And letting these…hoodlums in here.{box+}You might as well beg for bread on{line+}the street corner!
entries.text:
الملك: الذنب ذنبك لأنك غادرت القلعة!
وسمحت لهؤلاء… الأوباش بالدخول إلى هنا.
لم يبق لك إلا أن تتسولي الخبز على نواصي الشوارع!

entries.context: Message 1085 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Stop it!{line+}They're my friends!
Message 1086 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: They're a disgrace to this family!
entries.text: الملك: إنهم عار على هذه العائلة!

entries.context: Message 1087 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Father, you, you…
Message 1088 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: You care more about your{line+}country than me…or mother!!
entries.text: {Marle}: أنت تهتم ببلادك أكثر مما تهتم بي… أو بأمي!!

entries.context: Message 1089 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: What…?
Message 1090 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: You, …you killed mother!
Message 1091 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: !!
Message 1092 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Get… OUT OF HERE this instant!!!{line+}I never want to see your face again!
entries.text: الملك: اخرجي… من هنا في الحال!!!{line}لا أريد أن أرى وجهك مرة أخرى!

entries.context: Message 1093 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Good riddance!
Message 1094 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: We're no longer family!{line+}Do as you wish!!
entries.text: الملك: لم نعد عائلة بعد الآن!{line}افعلي ما يحلو لك!!

entries.context: Message 1095 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: ……
Message 1096 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: C'mon, let's check out the{line+}fair!
Message 1097 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey, don't come in here without{line}permission!
entries.text: مهلا، لا تدخل إلى هنا دون إذن!

entries.context: Message 1098 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey, sorry 'bout that.{line}The old lady's handlin' the kitchen.{box}Gotta tread softly around here!{box}The gist of this is that she can{line}cook…but she can yell, too.
entries.text:
آه، آسف على ما حدث.{line}فالعجوز هي من تدير المطبخ.
هنا يجب أن تمشي على رؤوس أصابعك!
خلاصة القول إنها تجيد الطبخ…{line}لكنها تجيد الصراخ أيضا.

entries.context: Message 1099 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Getting ready for the Millennial Fair.
Message 1100 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The chef's ancestor had a cook-off{line}with {Magus}'s troops.
entries.text: أحد أجداد الطاهية خاض مسابقة طبخ ضد جيش {Magus}.

entries.context: Message 1101 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Hey!!
Message 1102 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Leave it!
Message 1103 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oh, dear!{line}I didn't recognize you, Princess {Nadia}!
entries.text: يا إلهي!{line}لم أعرفك يا سمو الأميرة ناديا!

entries.context: Message 1104 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm in charge of the Princess'{line}education!
Message 1105 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm in charge of her physical education!
Message 1106 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm in charge of discipline.{line}And she's missed almost every lesson{line}this year!
entries.text: أنا المسؤول عن الانضباط.{line}وقد تغيبت عن كل الدروس تقريبا هذا العام!

entries.context: Message 1107 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's you!{box}Where's Princess {Nadia}?{box}Tell her to return to the castle, please.
entries.text:
إنه أنت!
أين الأميرة ناديا؟
أرجوك، قل لها أن تعود إلى القلعة.

entries.context: Message 1108 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Since it IS our 1000th Anniversary,{line}The King has, for the time being,{line}ordered probation for {Crono}.
entries.text: بما أنها ذكرانا الألفية بالذات، أمر الملك بإطلاق سراح {Crono} تحت المراقبة مؤقتا.

entries.context: Message 1109 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King awaits the return of his{line}daughter.
Message 1110 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Only the Chancellor thought {Crono}{line}was guilty.
entries.text: لم يكن أحد يرى أن {Crono} مذنب سوى المستشار.

entries.context: Message 1111 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Without Princess {Nadia}, this castle's{line}dead.
entries.text: من دون الأميرة ناديا، لا حياة في هذه القلعة.

entries.context: Message 1112 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I, too, hope Princess {Nadia} returns.
entries.text: وأنا أيضا أتمنى أن تعود الأميرة ناديا.

entries.context: Message 1113 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Princess {Nadia}'s a dead ringer for{line}her mother. That's why the King's so{line}strict with her.
entries.text: الأميرة ناديا صورة طبق الأصل عن أمها، ولهذا يعاملها الملك بكل هذه الصرامة.

entries.context: Message 1114 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We're about to begin celebrating, but{line}with the King like that…
entries.text: نحن على وشك بدء الاحتفال، لكن الملك على هذه الحال…

entries.context: Message 1115 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Due to the King's orders, the court is{line}adjourned.
entries.text: بأمر من الملك، رفعت جلسات المحكمة.

entries.context: Message 1116 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Due to the King's orders, the court is{line}adjourned.
entries.text: بأمر من الملك، رفعت جلسات المحكمة.

entries.context: Message 1117 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Mr. Pierre awaits downstairs.
entries.text: السيد بيير ينتظر في الطابق السفلي.

entries.context: Message 1118 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm your lawyer, Pierre.{line}The King has been so gloomy since{line}Princess {Nadia}'s disappearance…{box}Listening to my story, he has concluded{line}that it was NOT a kidnapping…{box}It's taken time, but I think he{line}understands.{box}Still, the Chancellor's acting weird.{line}He may give us some trouble…
entries.text:
أنا محاميك، بيير.{line}لقد ظل الملك كئيبا جدا منذ اختفاء الأميرة ناديا…
وبعد أن استمع إلى روايتي، خلص إلى أن ما حدث لم يكن اختطافا على الإطلاق…
استغرق الأمر وقتا، لكنني أظنه قد فهم.
ومع ذلك، فإن المستشار يتصرف بغرابة.{line}قد يسبب لنا بعض المتاعب…

entries.context: Message 1119 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Chancellor lost it right around the{line}time he ordered that Dragon Tank to{line}be built!
entries.text: فقد المستشار صوابه في الفترة التي أمر فيها ببناء دبابة التنين تلك!

entries.context: Message 1120 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The Chancellor hired all those soldiers{line}that work in the jail.
entries.text: المستشار هو من وظف كل أولئك الجنود الذين يعملون في السجن.

entries.context: Message 1121 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Those jail guardians were an odd{line}bunch.{box}We got cold stares from them.{line}It's like they weren't even human!
entries.text:
حراس السجن أولئك كانوا جماعة غريبة الأطوار.
كانوا يرمقوننا بنظرات باردة.{line}كأنهم لم يكونوا بشرا أصلا!

entries.context: Message 1122 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I heard the Chancellor really gave it to{line}the King in court.
entries.text: سمعت أن المستشار هاجم الملك بلا رحمة في المحكمة.

entries.context: Message 1123 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Come, Princess {Nadia}…
Message 1124 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oh, woe is me…
Message 1125 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): All right, forget it!{line}Beat it, you guys!!
Message 1126 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): ……{box}I've got nothing to say!
Message 1127 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: W, what's that?
Message 1128 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Your… favorite.
Message 1129 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: ……{box+}For me?
Message 1130 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Let's see…
Message 1131 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): SERVANT: What is it, sir?!
Message 1132 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: What…!!
Message 1133 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: How dare you…?!{box+}Giving me something this rich when{line+}you KNOW I have high cholesterol…!
entries.text:
الملك: كيف تجرئين…؟!
تقدمين لي طعاما دسما كهذا وأنت تعلمين تمام العلم أنني أعاني من ارتفاع الكوليسترول…!

entries.context: Message 1134 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: But…it's your favorite!
Message 1135 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: This is the last straw!{line+}Now I know how you REALLY feel!
entries.text: الملك: لقد طفح الكيل!{line}الآن عرفت حقيقة مشاعرك نحوي!

entries.context: Message 1136 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Father, NO…!
Message 1137 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: Leave!{line+}NOW!!!!{line+}Never show your face here again!!
entries.text: الملك: اخرجي!{line}حالا!!!!{line}إياك أن تريني وجهك هنا مرة أخرى!!

entries.context: Message 1138 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Father!!
Message 1139 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King does not wish to see anybody.
entries.text: لا يرغب الملك في رؤية أحد.

entries.context: Message 1140 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): If you must know, he's been bedridden{line}since then.{line}He's emotionally drained.
entries.text: إن كان لا بد أن تعرف، فهو طريح الفراش منذ ذلك الحين.{line}إنه منهك نفسيا.

entries.context: Message 1141 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Why not give the King a present?{box}He's been known to love jerky…
entries.text:
لم لا تقدم هدية إلى الملك؟
فمن المعروف أنه يحب اللحم المجفف…

entries.context: Message 1142 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Jerky?{box}Seems one of his ancestors first made{line}it, but I don't know the recipe.
entries.text:
اللحم المجفف؟
يبدو أن أحد أجداده هو أول من صنعه، لكنني لا أعرف الوصفة.

entries.context: Message 1143 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Urgh…!{box}You'll see, you'll be put on ice!
Message 1144 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Oh, my…{box}That {Crono}, he'll be strung up!
entries.text:
يا إلهي…
أما {Crono} ذاك، فسينتهي به الأمر على حبل المشنقة!

entries.context: Message 1145 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King is deeply concerned about{line}Princess {Nadia}.
entries.text: يشعر الملك بقلق بالغ على الأميرة ناديا.

entries.context: Message 1146 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): But being a King, he keeps it all locked{line}up inside.
entries.text: لكن بما أنه الملك، فهو يكتم كل ذلك في صدره.

entries.context: Message 1147 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): After his wife's death, he only lived for{line}Princess {Nadia}.
entries.text: بعد وفاة زوجته، لم يعد يعيش إلا من أجل الأميرة ناديا.

entries.context: Message 1148 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Cut the foolishness!
Message 1149 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Jeez, I ain't gonna poison the{line}Chancellor.
Message 1150 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I can't get anything done, with you{line}standing around!
entries.text: لا أستطيع إنجاز أي شيء وأنت واقف فوق رأسي!

entries.context: Message 1151 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The trial of the century is about to{line}begin.{line}Who's, you ask?{box}King Guardia's, of course!
entries.text:
محاكمة القرن على وشك أن تبدأ.{line}تسأل محاكمة من؟
محاكمة الملك غارديا، بالطبع!

entries.context: Message 1152 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): They say the King sold off the royal{line}treasures.
entries.text: يقولون إن الملك باع الكنوز الملكية.

entries.context: Message 1153 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King ordered that the court be{line}locked until the trial's over.
entries.text: أمر الملك بإغلاق قاعة المحكمة حتى تنتهي المحاكمة.

entries.context: Message 1154 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Same thing on the left…{box}But weren't there some stairs, over{line}there?
entries.text:
الأمر نفسه على اليسار…
لكن ألم يكن هناك درج في تلك الناحية؟

entries.context: Message 1155 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The decision is about to be handed{line}down.{line}The King requests that no one enter or{line}leave.
entries.text: الحكم على وشك الصدور.{line}ويطلب الملك ألا يدخل أحد ولا يخرج.

entries.context: Message 1156 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's locked.
Message 1157 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Phew, finally!{line+}That beast, keepin' me locked up in{line+}here…!
entries.text: المستشار: يا للراحة، أخيرا!{line}ذلك الوحش! لقد حبسني هنا…!

entries.context: Message 1158 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Princess {Nadia}!{line+}Your friends, I presume?
entries.text: المستشار: يا سمو الأميرة ناديا!{line}هؤلاء أصدقاؤك، على ما أظن؟

entries.context: Message 1159 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): CHANCELLOR: Wait, I don't have time for{line+}this.{line+}I must prepare for the Moonlight{line+}Parade!
entries.text: المستشار: مهلا، ليس لدي وقت لهذا.{line}علي أن أستعد لموكب ضوء القمر!

entries.context: Message 1160 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Sorry, fellas.{line}I'm terribly embarrassed…{box}Take care of Princess {Nadia}, OK?
entries.text:
آسف يا رفاق.{line}أشعر بحرج شديد…
اعتنوا بالأميرة ناديا، اتفقنا؟

entries.context: Message 1161 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The real Chancellor's okay.{line}He took off to the Knight's room sayin'{line}he was gettin' ready for the parade!
entries.text: المستشار الحقيقي بخير.{line}لقد ذهب مسرعا إلى مهجع الفرسان قائلا إنه يستعد للموكب!

entries.context: Message 1162 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Princess {Nadia}!{line}At the moonlight parade, you shall{line}receive a lovely present from me!
entries.text: يا سمو الأميرة ناديا!{line}في موكب ضوء القمر، ستتلقين مني هدية جميلة!

entries.context: Message 1163 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Enjoy yourselves at the moonlight{line}parade!
entries.text: استمتعوا بوقتكم في موكب ضوء القمر!

entries.context: Message 1164 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm Pierre, the lawyer.{box}So, like, where's the real chancellor?
entries.text:
أنا المحامي بيير.
إذن، أين المستشار الحقيقي يا ترى؟

entries.context: Message 1165 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): I'm Pierre, the lawyer.{box}I've been planning the Millennial Parade{line}with the Chancellor.
entries.text:
أنا المحامي بيير.
أعمل مع المستشار على التخطيط لموكب الألفية.

entries.context: Message 1166 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Now we can go on with the moonlight{line}parade.
entries.text: الآن يمكننا إقامة موكب ضوء القمر كما هو مقرر.

entries.context: Message 1167 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Gonna be a great night.
Message 1168 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The parade's the grand finale.
Message 1169 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's the kind of parade that brings out{line}the kid in all of us.
entries.text: إنه موكب يوقظ الطفل الكامن في كل منا.

entries.context: Message 1170 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Princess, let's start with P.{line}E.!
entries.text: يا سمو الأميرة، لنبدأ بالتربية البدنية!

entries.context: Message 1171 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's no game, now !
Message 1172 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): No, we MUST start with discipline!
entries.text: لا، بل يجب أن نبدأ بالانضباط!

entries.context: Message 1173 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The soldiers hired by the fake{line}Chancellor were all monsters.
entries.text: الجنود الذين استأجرهم المستشار المزيف كانوا جميعا وحوشا.

entries.context: Message 1174 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Now THIS is what I call a 1000th{line}Anniversary.
Message 1175 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): No one could tell that the Chancellor{line}was a beast…
entries.text: لم يفطن أحد إلى أن المستشار كان وحشا…

entries.context: Message 1176 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): The King's finally feeling better.
Message 1177 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): That's great to hear…!
Message 1178 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Come on, now!!
Message 1179 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): We owe it all to you!{line}Eat all you want.
entries.text: نحن مدينون لكم بكل شيء!{line}كلوا قدر ما تشاؤون.

entries.context: Message 1180 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Please have a seat over here.
Message 1181 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): What will you have?{line+}   Refresh bread.{line+}   Power roast.{line+}   {Crono} special.
Message 1182 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Coming right up.
Message 1183 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): A fine choice{line}This dish is named after a hero from{line}the past.
entries.text: اختيار موفق!{line}يحمل هذا الطبق اسم بطل من الماضي.

entries.context: Message 1184 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Here you are.
Message 1185 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}             MP recovered!
Message 1186 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}             HP recovered!
Message 1187 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}          HP/MP recovered!
Message 1188 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): KING: I'll let you exit the castle, BUT!{box+}…you be careful, now.{line+}Take care of her!
entries.text:
الملك: سأسمح لك بالخروج من القلعة، ولكن!
…انتبهي لنفسك جيدا.{line}وأنتم، اعتنوا بها!

entries.context: Message 1189 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: …Yessir!
Message 1190 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: You can count on us!
Message 1191 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Indeed, Sir.
Message 1192 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Ayla}: You no worry!{line+}{Ayla} protect {Marle}!
Message 1193 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): It's my turn, now…
Message 1194 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Marle}: Melchior!
Message 1195 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Lucca}: Melchior!
Message 1196 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Robo}: Mr. Melchior!
Message 1197 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Frog}: Melchior!
Message 1198 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {Ayla}: Melchior!

Message 1199 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): MELCHIOR: Can't let you run the whole{line+}show. Let me make some weapons{line+}from the Rainbow Shell!{box+}Finally time for me to do somethin'.{line+}Watch and learn!
entries.text:
ملكيور: لن أدعكم تتولون كل شيء وحدكم. دعوني أصنع بعض الأسلحة من الصدفة القزحية!
حان الوقت أخيرا لأفعل شيئا.{line}راقبوا وتعلموا!

entries.context: Message 1200 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}    Sealed with a mysterious power…
Message 1201 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): Reacting to the pendant, something{line}inside begins to glow. Remove it?{line+}   Yes.{line+}   No.
entries.text: يتفاعل شيء ما في الداخل مع القلادة،{line}ويبدأ في التوهج. أتخرجه؟{line}{choice}نعم.{line}{choice}لا.

entries.context: Message 1202 of the guardia table (Castle Guardia in 600 and 1000...): {line+}    Level up for the Red Vest!{box}{line+}           Got the Red Mail!
entries.text:
{line}ارتفع مستوى الصدرية الحمراء!
{line}حصلت على الدرع الأحمر!
